*This is a {Advertised Permanent / Temporary}, Full Time vacancy.*
**The role**
Department: Technology & Transformation
Reports To: Change Manager / Project Manager
Contract Duration: 6 Months
Location: Colton, Leeds (Office Based)
Job Purpose
The IT Project Delivery Specialist will support the successful delivery of key strategic Technology & Transformation projects across First Locate, with a primary focus on migrating business files and shared network drives to Microsoft SharePoint, followed by the decommissioning of legacy servers.
Working closely with the Project Manager, internal IT teams, external technology partners and business stakeholders, the post holder will be responsible for coordinating project activities, managing delivery dependencies and ensuring effective business engagement throughout implementation.
The role requires an experienced IT project delivery professional who has successfully delivered similar migration and infrastructure projects previously and can quickly apply that experience to drive progress, manage risks and ensure successful outcomes.
A key focus will be ensuring business stakeholders are actively engaged, understand the changes and are supported in adopting new ways of working, with minimal disruption to business operations.
Areas of Accountability
Project Delivery & Coordination
* Support the Project Manager in planning, coordinating and delivering key strategic IT projects.
* Take ownership of agreed project workstreams, activities, milestones and dependencies.
* Coordinate technical delivery activities undertaken by internal IT teams and external technology partners.
* Maintain project plans, risk and issue logs, progress reporting and implementation documentation.
* Proactively identify delivery challenges and work with stakeholders to resolve issues and maintain momentum.
* Ensure projects are delivered in line with agreed timescales, business requirements and quality standards.
SharePoint Migration
* Coordinate the end-to-end migration of business files and shared network drives to Microsoft SharePoint.
* Engage business stakeholders to understand existing file storage, access requirements and working practices.
* Work with technical teams to agree migration approaches, implementation plans, testing and validation activities.
* Coordinate business readiness, communications, training and user adoption activities.
* Ensure appropriate testing, data validation and stakeholder sign-off are completed before migration is considered successful.
* Support the transition to new document management practices and ensure colleagues are confident using the new environment.
Server Decommissioning
* Coordinate the planning and delivery of legacy server decommissioning following the successful SharePoint migration.
* Work with IT teams and external providers to identify dependencies, risks and decommissioning requirements.
* Track technical delivery activities, ensuring agreed milestones and prerequisites are completed.
* Coordinate stakeholder communications, implementation planning and business validation.
* Ensure appropriate approvals, documentation and handover arrangements are completed before servers are decommissioned.
Stakeholder Engagement & Change Adoption
* Build effective relationships across Technology, Operations and wider business functions.
* Actively engage stakeholders throughout project delivery to secure buy-in and maintain confidence in the changes.
* Understand the operational impact of technology changes and work with stakeholders to address concerns and barriers.
* Coordinate business communications, user testing, training and implementation readiness.
* Ensure changes are successfully embedded and deliver the intended business benefits.
Key Deliverables
* Successful coordination and delivery of the SharePoint migration, including business validation and stakeholder sign-off.
* Successful coordination of legacy server decommissioning following completion of the migration.
* Effective project governance, progress reporting and management of delivery risks and dependencies.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and successful adoption of new ways of working.
* Minimal disruption to business operations throughout project implementation.
* Complete project documentation and effective handover to operational and technical support teams.
Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Essential
* Demonstrable experience successfully delivering similar IT migration or infrastructure transformation projects.
* Previous experience coordinating migrations from on-premises file servers or shared network drives to Microsoft SharePoint Online.
* Experience supporting server decommissioning or infrastructure rationalisation projects.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and the practical challenges associated with migration, access permissions and user adoption.
* Proven ability to coordinate internal technical teams and external IT suppliers to deliver agreed project outcomes.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and influencing skills, including experience working with non-technical business stakeholders.
* Experience managing project plans, risks, issues, dependencies, testing and implementation readiness.
* Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of delivery activities.
* A proactive, delivery-focused approach, with the ability to quickly establish relationships and deliver results within a fixed-term contract.
Desirable
* Experience delivering technology projects within Financial Services or another regulated environment.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and wider Microsoft 365 capabilities.
* Experience working with managed IT service providers and outsourced technical teams.
* Familiarity with recognised project management methodologies such as PRINCE2 or Agile.
* Experience delivering technology transformation in a small or medium-sized organisation.
Why choose First Locate?
We are a Real Living Wage employer and a Gold accredited Investor in People. We believe that our people can be the difference. So, at First Locate we have a range of benefits which include:
* A fantastic culture with little perks along the way including flexible working, family leave.
* Simply Health Rewards Package – Cash back on Optical, Dental, Physiotherapy, Prescription charges and much more
* My Wellbeing Service which included 24/7 support and advice line. 24/7 GP access. Counselling Service, discounted Gym Membership and much more.
* Trained mental health first aiders on all sites.
What Happens Next?
We’ll be in touch if you’re application is successful so keep an eye on your emails! We’ll share your CV with the hiring manager to review. If we feel we may be a good match, then we’ll arrange a short call to learn more about you and answer any questions you have. We will then invite to interview. Our interview process is tailored to each role and can be in person or held remotely. Full details will be confirmed if you’re application is progressed to the next stage.

# Lead Software Engineer (Hybrid)
London, England, United Kingdom
### # **Lead Engineer**
**Location**: Waterloo, London, England, UK | **Hybrid** (1 day per week in office)
---
## **Who We Are**
At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.
Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.
Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.
If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.
## **Who You Are**
You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 7+ years. You can be the go-to leader for any software development engagement. You have a broad and deep range of expertise that allows you to make an immediate impact on projects. In your previous experience, you have:
* Successfully led high-stakes consulting engagements from discovery to production
* Built high-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served
* Written production-quality code using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Scala, R, and SQL
* Leveraged AI-assistive development tools for tasks like scaffolding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and documentation
* Experience building or integrating AI/ML-powered features into products or systems (e.g., recommendation engines, NLP models, computer vision, predictive analytics)
* Used context-appropriate automated testing to inform software design choices and catch bugs
* Debugged and refactored pre-existing code to incrementally improve it
* Collaborated with teams using Git, MacOS/Linux, and CI/CD
* Remedied architecture-level concerns such as scalability, security, reliability, and performance
* Brought together people from different functions and perspectives in forums that encourage idea sharing, collaboration, and problem solving
* Made thoughtful recommendations and set direction in the face of ambiguity
* Mentored and shared knowledge with colleagues
* Actively sought out and effectively given feedback
* Communicated empathically with stakeholders and colleagues
* Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs
## **What You’ll Do At 8th Light**
As a lead technologist on projects, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, through a variety of technologies and frameworks over the course of your career with us. You’ll lead more complicated projects, leading teams to do so. You’ll work with colleagues who share your passion for technology solutions. You’ll invest time developing your skills and sharing what you know. You’ll be responsible for:
* Making immediate contributions to projects, rapidly building trust with clients
* Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines
* Leading architecture and software design discussions
* Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
* Generating new potential solutions to challenges (technical and non-technical) in partnership with team members and clients
* Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
* Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
* Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
* Ensuring your team has a healthy, prioritized, estimated backlog
* Managing high-level project roadmaps as the team lead for large engagements
* Maintaining relationships with client technical leaders
* Regular syncs with the client to provide status updates, and for identifying and evaluating risks and presenting potential solutions
* Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
* Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes
## **Strongly Preferred Skills**
We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:
* Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
* Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
* Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
* DevSecOps & DevOps
* MLOps
* Infrastructure as Code
Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real-world career experiences.
## **How You’ll be Supported**
At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future.
* Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
* A robust L&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
* Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development
* Coworking support for our global team
* 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees
See our full list of Benefits.
## **A Note on Compensation**
At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.
We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Lead Engineer position within London is: £76,023-95,029 GBP.
Reach out to recruiting@8thlight.com for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.
## **8th Light Hubs and Geographies**
8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.
* **London Co-working:** Employees working from our London hub follow a hybrid model, which includes a minimum of one day per week in our Waterloo Office. This co-working day is designed to encourage collaboration and further strengthen our community.In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.
We hope to see you apply!

We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably.
Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There's still so much to build, and we'd like your help with it.
## **About this role**
As the Senior Talent Partner at Ably, you'll be our sole in-house recruiter, reporting to our VP of People and owning hiring end-to-end, from calibrating the brief with the hiring manager through to signed offer. You’ll be responsible for everything that makes hiring work: how we interview, the tools we use, how we source, and how candidates experience Ably. There’s a good foundation in place, and you’ll decide what to sharpen first and have the autonomy and backing to do it.
In a 60-person company, every hire changes the team, so this role exists to raise the bar: looking wider than the first good candidate, pushing back when a brief is off, making the case for waiting when the evidence isn't there, and judging your success by who is still thriving a year in, not how fast we filled the seat.
Ably is an infrastructure company, and a large share of our team are deeply technical engineers. You'll run full-cycle recruiting across the company, but engineering is where the depth matters most. You'll understand what we build well enough to hold a credible conversation with distributed systems engineers, tell depth from polish, and explain why our problems are worth their time. You'll work closely with hiring managers, right up to our CTO.
## **Day to day, you will**
* **Calibrate hiring briefs before we go to market.** Work with each hiring manager to turn complex technical requirements into a clear picture of who we need, and give honest feedback when the brief needs to change.
* **Find and close great people.** Run outbound sourcing, screens and interviews, and close offers for engineering, GTM and other roles, supporting offers and compensation conversations alongside our People team.
* **Make our interviews better.** Build on our structured interviews and scorecards so every process is fair, consistent and good at telling depth from polish.
* **Get more out of our tools, with AI at the centre.** Make the most of Greenhouse and our hiring reporting, and put AI to work across sourcing, outreach, screening and admin so more of your time goes to the conversations that need a person. Use it as much as you can and show us what works.
* **Manage and negotiate our agency relationships.** Decide where agencies add the most value, set the terms, and hold them to account.
* **Be Ably’s voice with candidates and the technical community.** Shape our employer brand and candidate experience, and make sure new hires land well before they start.
## **We'd love to hear from you if you have**
* A track record of finding and closing high-calibre engineers, ideally in infrastructure or distributed systems, and the technical grounding to earn engineers' respect.
* Strong judgement when partnering with hiring managers: calibrating a brief, giving honest feedback, and running a structured, fair interview process.
* Proven full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally as the sole or lead recruiter in a start-up or scale-up, hiring across the UK and Europe.
* Hands-on outbound sourcing and market mapping, with the numbers to show what works, and a habit of using AI in how you work.
* Experience managing recruitment agencies, including negotiating terms and holding them to account.
## **Bonus points if you have**
* Experience hiring for developer tools, AI, or open source companies.
* A background in agency recruiting.
* Familiarity with Greenhouse ATS.
* An active presence in tech or recruiting communities, online or in person, and comfort being a public face for Ably.
## **What’s it like to work at Ably?**
You'll join a team of around 60 people, working directly alongside senior engineering and leadership. No layers, no bureaucracy, and real ownership from day one.
### Remote-first
We hire the best people wherever they are across the UK and Europe, trust them to own their work, and share decisions and feedback openly. Twice a year, in February and August, we all meet in person, and we expect everyone to be there.
Remote-first comes with trade-offs. On one side: flexibility, no commute, long stretches of focus time, and a wider pool of people to hire from. On the other: it can feel isolating, relationships take effort to build, and you miss the chance conversations an office creates. As our only recruiter, you'll need to manage your own time and stay close to the hiring managers and candidates you work with.
If you do your best work with trust and autonomy, this will suit you. If you'd rather have an office around you every day, it probably isn't the right fit.
Our six values shape how we work day to day:
* **Open for all.** We default to sharing openly: source, decisions, and feedback, with open minds to match.
* **Tech needs humanity.** We build with empathy, for colleagues and developers alike.
* **Even the best do better.** We keep raising our own bar, driven by curiosity, not complacency.
* **Bias for action.** Once we know enough to act, we act, rather than waiting for certainty.
* **Dependable by default.** We take real ownership of what we ship and what we promise.
* **Bold creativity wins.** We treat big constraints as a reason to think differently, not less.
You can read more about how we defined these values on our blog, and see the team behind them on our careers page.
## Diversity, inclusion, and belonging at Ably
We believe our differences as individuals are what make us great. Our people are at the heart of what we do, and we encourage everyone to be their most authentic self at Ably: we see inclusivity and openness as fundamental to our long-term success. We encourage applications from all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, parental status, race, religion, educational background, or neurodiversity. *If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value open source, and love solving hard problems, we'd love to hear from you, regardless of whether you fit the job description exactly or not. If in doubt, drop us an email;; we're happy to give you advice on your application.*

* A remote-first and flexible work environment. Our London office (next to Old Street) is there whenever you want it. Aside from our company get-togethers, you're welcome to work wherever suits you best.
* Equity. We're a growing start-up, and we want everyone to share in the company's success through our EMI share options programme.

* Enhanced parental leave, so you can spend time with your new family member: up to 16 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary, depending on length of service.
* A home workstation budget of £500 on joining (and £150 per year after that), so your home office serves you well.
* A personal learning and development budget of £1000 a year, plus 5% L&D time during working hours to build your skills.
* Private healthcare with BUPA.
* A medical cash plan covering a range of medical and dental costs.
* Mental wellbeing coaching and counselling from Self Space.
* A monthly wellbeing budget via Juno.
* Life assurance and income protection.
* Access to Tech and Cycle to Work schemes.
* A weekly snack allowance for our end-of-week "Need to Know" meeting.
* A fully-paid one-month sabbatical after five years with Ably.

Remote-first comes with trade-offs. On one side: flexibility, no commute, long stretches of focus time, and a wider pool of people to hire from. On the other: it can feel isolating, relationships take effort to build, and you miss the chance conversations an office creates. As our only recruiter, you'll need to manage your own time and stay close to the hiring managers and candidates you work with.
If you do your best work with trust and autonomy, this will suit you. If you'd rather have an office around you every day, it probably isn't the right fit.
Our six values shape how we work day to day:
* **Open for all.** We default to sharing openly: source, decisions, and feedback, with open minds to match.
* **Tech needs humanity.** We build with empathy, for colleagues and developers alike.
* **Even the best do better.** We keep raising our own bar, driven by curiosity, not complacency.
* **Bias for action.** Once we know enough to act, we act, rather than waiting for certainty.
* **Dependable by default.** We take real ownership of what we ship and what we promise.
* **Bold creativity wins.** We treat big constraints as a reason to think differently, not less.
You can read more about how we defined these values on our blog, and see the team behind them on our careers page.

## **💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.**
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.
What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
Our platform now powers **Total Triage** to manage patient demand, and **Self-Book**,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with **Patient Questionnaires** for long-term conditions, while **Accumail** finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with **Accurx Scribe**, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.
## ## The role
It's a hands-on, delivery-focused role, and you'll **make an impact from the start** in risk management, security advisory, customer and tender responses, audit readiness and our data strategy.
**This isn't a security engineering role.** You won't configure firewalls or run vulnerability scans. Instead, you'll understand our technical environment well enough to spot risks and gaps, then recommend best practices for Engineering, DevOps and IT to put in place. A background in compliance management alone won't be enough for this role.
You'll report to our Senior Information Security Officer, who owns our GRC framework, ISO 27001 programme, CE/CE+ & DSPT compliance, and the security risk register. **You'll help deliver across all of it.**
## **Challenges you’ll solve...**
* **Own risk management:** run risk sessions across the business, keep the risk register current, write clear risk reports and chase treatment actions to completion
* **Advise the business:** be the security voice with Engineering, DevOps, IT and Product, and a first point of contact for security questions from every team
* **Handle customers, tenders and suppliers:** answer security questionnaires and tenders accurately, and assess suppliers before we approve them
* **Keep us audit-ready:** gather evidence all year round for Cyber Essentials Plus, DSPT and ISO 27001, and flag control gaps with practical fixes
* **Deliver our data strategy:** drive the data classification and access control programmes forward with data owners
## **You should apply if...**
* **You have hands-on infosec and risk experience**: ideally in health-tech, regulated SaaS or software development. You've run risk sessions, managed a risk register and reported on risk to senior stakeholders.
* **You possess technical depth to hold your own:** You understand authentication vs authorisation, least privilege, IAM, network segmentation and firewalls, patch and vulnerability management, endpoint protection and cloud infrastructure.
* **You understand frameworks:** ISO 27001, DSPT, NIST and Cyber Essentials Plus, and a sense of what proportionate looks like in a fast-moving product company.
* **You work fast and independently:** You manage your own workload, flag blockers early and can move between a tender, a questionnaire and an engineering conversation in the same day.
* **You care about healthcare:** and know the data we protect belongs to patients and clinicians.
**Nice to have:** enterprise risk management experience, and having been through a CE+ audit cycle.
## **What’s in it for you?**
You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers
* **£65,000 - £75,000 salary,** plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team
* **Equity:** £15,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create
* **Benefits to suit you:** adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life
* **Built for collaboration:** We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week
* **Close to our users:** Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

## Description
## Job Title:
Data Scientist, Ricochet Anti-Cheat (Call of Duty)

R028031
## Job Description:
**Your Mission**
Call of Duty is one of the most iconic and successful video game franchises in the world, delivering unforgettable experiences to millions of players every day. At the heart of that experience is **fair play**, and that is where the **Ricochet Anti-Cheat** team comes in.
Our mission is to protect the integrity of the online experience, ensuring every player enjoys a level playing field. As a Data Scientist on Ricochet, you will analyze, investigate, and translate complex data into insights that help detect, prevent, and respond to cheating across Call of Duty live titles.
This role can be based in either our Sherman Oaks, CA or our Vancouver, BC office and follows an onsite work schedule of four days per week. Work arrangements may change at the company's discretion to meet business needs.
**The Role**
We are seeking a Data Scientist to help secure the Call of Duty franchise by producing structured insights, experiments, and analyses that improve Ricochet anti-cheat outcomes at scale.
In this role, you will partner with anti-cheat engineers, analysts, operations specialists, game designers, and producers to answer ambiguous questions, evaluate detections, measure model impact, and identify new opportunities for anti-cheat initiatives. You will support the broader Ricochet organization through consultation, data analysis, data engineering, experimentation, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong statistical and data science fundamentals with curiosity about adversarial player behavior, a passion for competitive integrity, and the communication skills to make complex findings actionable for technical and non-technical partners.
**What you bring to the table**
* Analyze gameplay telemetry, enforcement data, behavioral signals, and other large-scale datasets to investigate cheating patterns and anti-cheat outcomes.
* Collaborate on the ETL, data analysis, and measurement strategy for machine-learning projects that enhance detection, prevention, and response to cheating.
* Design and execute experiments and analyses that measure the impact of models, detections, interventions, and enforcement workflows on players and the business.
* Answer ambiguous questions with practical, evidence-based recommendations that help Ricochet prioritize anti-cheat initiatives.
* Produce dashboards, recurring reports, and executive-level summaries that clearly communicate results, trends, impediments, and impact.
* Partner with game designers, engineers, producers, analysts, and operations teams to identify new opportunities for anti-cheat improvements.
* Support validation of new anti-cheat detections and model changes before broader deployment, with attention to effectiveness and false-positive risk.
* Help improve the quality, consistency, and transparency of anti-cheat data pipelines, metrics, analysis standards, and reporting practices.
* Stay current on advances in anti-cheat technology, statistical analysis, experimentation, data science, and adversarial behavior analysis.
* Learn from senior team members, share knowledge with peers, and contribute to a culture of fairness, accountability, and continuous improvement in game security.
**Player Profile**
Minimum requirements:
Experience
* 3+ years of experience using data science to solve real-world problems with measurable impact on users and the business.
* Experience working with large data volumes for production, analytics, experimentation, or reporting purposes.
* Working knowledge of experimentation methods, impact measurement, statistical analysis, and metrics development.
* Experience building or maintaining dashboards, reports, and repeatable analytical workflows for stakeholders.
Knowledge & Skills
* Master's degree or equivalent work experience in Data Science, Computer Science, Data Analysis, Statistics, or a related field.
* Competence with Python, SQL, and PySpark for data analysis, data engineering, and production-scale workflows.
* Strong understanding of data analysis, statistics, experimentation, measurement design, and practical model evaluation.
* Familiarity with large data lake or warehouse environments such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar platforms.
* Ability to synthesize multiple data sources into clear conclusions, recommendations, and decision-ready narratives.
* Practical understanding of data quality, ETL, schema evolution, and analytical reproducibility in large-scale environments.
* Ability to prioritize effectively across investigations, analyses, stakeholder requests, and long-term data science initiatives.
Key Attributes
* Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including concise documentation and executive-ready reporting.
* Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and ability to work through ambiguous problems with incomplete or noisy data.
* Ability to learn from senior team members and contribute to the growth and success of others on the team.
* Passion for multiplayer gaming and preserving competitive integrity.
**Extra Points**
Minimum requirements:
Experience
* Experience developing agentic orchestration workflows that result in production outcomes.
* Experience with machine-learning-assisted detection systems, model monitoring, or adversarial behavior analysis.
* Experience with game telemetry, player behavioral analysis, or live-service game operations.
* Experience using SQL, Python, or scripting to automate repeatable analysis, anomaly detection, or reporting workflows.
Knowledge & Skills
* Familiarity with Call of Duty gameplay systems and mechanics, competitive multiplayer ecosystems, or common cheating methods.
Key Attributes
* Video game enthusiasm and curiosity about how data can improve fairness and player trust.
**Your Platform**
Activision Central Tech works to support our development studios and their titles. Comprised of seven main teams, we have many specialties including big data, privacy and security, motion capture and animation pipeline technologies, graphics, build and infrastructure for studio development and data centers, optimization, systems programming and online services including matchmaking and networking. Central Tech is distributed globally with offices across the U.S., and in Canada, England, Ireland and Japan.
Most of our teams are comprised of both engineering and research talent, allowing us to always have an eye on the future. Our talented engineers help with title development and provide valuable knowledge sharing between studios while our researchers are action-oriented and keep a strong connection with the needs of the game studios.
Central Tech is part of Activision. To learn more about us and our research, please visit us at https://research.activision.com/.
**Our World**
At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash BandicootTM, Tony Hawk’sTM Pro SkaterTM, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.
We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.
We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.
**Ready to Activate Your Future?**
We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.
We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to accommodationrequests@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:
* Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
* 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
* Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
* Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;
* If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.
Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting https://www.benefitsforeveryworld.com/.

**Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.**
We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.
### About the role
You'll work across LabOS — our internal software platform — building the orchestration layer that coordinates everything from experiment scheduling to execution to data capture and results processing. This is full-stack product engineering at the intersection of software and physical-world biology.

* Building custom AI agents and tooling that automate decisions across the experiment lifecycle, from protocol design to troubleshooting failed results
* Turning proprietary hardware into API-controllable devices that agents and software can operate programmatically
* Designing scheduling systems that coordinate dozens of lab instruments with complex dependency chains

You’ll also help shape our sales strategy: identifying promising markets, bringing customer insight into the business and working with marketing to develop qualified opportunities.

* Develop new business: identify and approach prospective customers, qualify inbound enquiries and build opportunities across the UK.

**Purpose of the role:**
To ensure the organisation is compliant with all current Environmental, Health and Safety legislation.
To work at all levels of the business to drive a culture of EHS best practice across the organisation.
To provide effective governance, assurance and continual improvement across occupational health and safety, environmental compliance, sustainability and the EHS management system.
**Duties and responsibilities:**
* Design, develop, implement and oversee the organisation’s EHS programmes and procedures to safeguard employees, contractors, visitors and surrounding communities.
* Maintain and continually improve the EHS Management System in alignment with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, including document control, management review and continual improvement activities.
* Maintain the site EHS legal and other requirements register, assess regulatory changes and ensure actions are implemented to maintain compliance.
* Develop and maintain a risk-based internal EHS audit programme, ensuring findings, corrective actions and effectiveness reviews are completed and reported to senior management.
* Develop, maintain and report on the site EHS risk register, ensuring significant risks are controlled, assigned and escalated appropriately.
* Lead or support incident, accident, near-miss and environmental event investigations, including root-cause analysis, statutory reporting and verification of corrective actions.
* Develop, maintain and report on auditable EHS metrics, dashboards and trend analysis, including leading and lagging indicators, near misses, incidents, RIDDOR and environmental performance.
* Manage environmental permitting and compliance requirements, including emissions and discharge monitoring, waste controls, statutory submissions, regulatory notifications and liaison with the Environment Agency and other relevant bodies.
* Co-ordinate site sustainability and ESG activities, including environmental objectives, corporate reporting, resource efficiency, carbon reduction and improvement programmes.
* Support the occupational health surveillance governance process in partnership with HR and operational managers, including the exposure and testing matrix, provider liaison, recalls, repeat surveillance, referrals, follow-up actions, records and programme effectiveness reviews.
* Administer and conduct suitable and sufficient risk assessments, including COSHH, DSEAR, workplace, task and occupational health assessments, ensuring identified actions are completed.
* Provide EHS governance for site projects and change activities, including management of change, CDM 2015 requirements, contractor competence, RAMS review, permit-to-work arrangements and project handover requirements.
* Oversee key statutory and operational safety programmes, including fire safety, emergency preparedness, PUWER, LOLER, occupational hygiene, hazardous substances, waste management and spill response, working with appointed competent persons where required.
* Establish and maintain EHS training, induction and competency arrangements for employees, contractors and managers, including the EHS training matrix and refresher requirements.
* Develop the culture of Health and Safety across all areas and functions of the business, delivering high levels of EHS engagement, consultation and participation.
* Chair EHS meetings and contribute to senior management reviews, providing accurate reports, minutes, actions, recommendations and escalation of significant risks or non-compliance.
* Act as a principal contact during regulatory inspections, certification audits and external assurance activities, coordinating evidence, responses and corrective actions.
* Carry out such other duties that may be reasonably requested.
**Person Specification:**
**Essential:**
*Qualifications*
* Relevant professional qualification in occupational health and safety, environmental management, engineering or a related discipline. NEBOSH Diploma or equivalent level qualification preferred.
* Current knowledge of UK environmental, health and safety legislation and recognised management system standards.
*Experience*
* Experience in an EHS management role within an engineering, manufacturing or similarly regulated environment.
* Experience of developing and maintaining EHS management systems, audit programmes, risk registers and legal compliance arrangements.
* Experience of regulatory liaison, incident investigation, contractor governance and senior management reporting.
*Technical Knowledge*
* Environmental permitting, emissions monitoring, waste management and environmental incident response.
* Occupational health surveillance governance and exposure-based health risk management.
* Risk assessment, COSHH, DSEAR, CDM 2015, PUWER, LOLER, fire safety and permit-to-work principles.
*Skills and Competencies*
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively at all levels of the organisation and with external regulators.
* Strong planning, prioritisation and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple compliance programmes and deadlines.
* Able to analyse and interpret complex data, identify trends and convert findings into practical actions.
* Confident in challenging unsafe or non-compliant activity and escalating material risks appropriately.
* Professional, objective and discreet when managing sensitive health, incident and regulatory information.
* Excellent IT skills and experience of producing clear EHS reports, dashboards and management information.
* Driven to continuously improve current practice and promote a positive, open and accountable EHS culture.
**Desirable:**
*Technical Knowledge*
* ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
* Root-cause analysis, corrective action management and EHS performance measurement.
*Skills and Competencies*
* Experience using AI-assisted tools to develop, maintain and optimise Environmental, Health and Safety Management Systems, including policy development, gap analysis, auditing and compliance management.

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
**Role Overview**
As our EMEA SMB Sales Manager, you will thrive in an environment with a high level of ambiguity and change while maintaining a customer-centric approach at scale. You will support and continue to build a data-driven and motivated team whose efforts will drive Apollo.io's business growth through new customer acquisition. You will directly manage a team of SMB AEs, overseeing the overall revenue and conversion rates of your team's portfolio. Your role includes providing 1:1 coaching and performance management, helping to develop processes and insights to grow the team today and influence program design for the future. You will identify and help build ongoing playbooks and influence the tooling AEs/AMs need for success. Additionally, you will manage impactful cross-functional projects and initiatives across Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding, Marketing, Legal, and Marketing.
### **Key Responsibilities**
* **Sales Strategy & Execution**:
+ Develop and implement sales strategies to drive revenue growth and achieve company objectives.
+ Analyze market trends and adjust sales strategies as needed.
+ Monitor competitors and industry developments to identify new business opportunities.
* **Team Leadership**:
+ Hire, Lead, motivate, and mentor a team of sales professionals.
+ Meet and exceed individual and team sales targets and ensure accountability.
+ Provide ongoing coaching, training, and development opportunities for the team.
+ Foster a collaborative and results-oriented team culture, including in person sales kicks offs within the US.
* **Performance Management**:
+ Monitor and analyze sales performance metrics.
+ Prepare regular sales forecasts, reports, and presentations for senior management.
+ Use data-driven insights to improve sales processes and team efficiency.
* **Client Relationship Management**:
+ Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders.
+ Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, marketing, product, customer success) to optimize client experience.
+ Address client concerns and resolve issues promptly to ensure satisfaction.
* **Business Development**:
+ Identify new business opportunities and work closely with the sales team to secure new clients.
+ Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows.
+ Negotiate contracts and close high-value deals with key clients.
* **Operational Excellence**:
+ Ensure sales operations are running efficiently and in compliance with company policies.
+ Collaborate with sales operations to streamline processes, tools, and technologies.
+ Drive continuous improvement in sales tactics, processes, and methodologies.
### **Eligibility**
* Good standing in performance - consistent quota attainment, averaging above 90% of team roll up quota.
* 4+ years of sales experience managing customer-facing sales / account management sales cycles. Proven track record of leading and coaching a team responsible for driving revenue growth, managing expansions, and increasing product adoption.
* Minimum 3+ years of manager experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to diverse audiences.
* Strong organizational skills, with expertise in prioritization and time management.
* Experience working cross-functionally with product teams to serve as the voice of the customer.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity with perseverance and a positive attitude.
* Must be able to go into the London office three days per week.
### We are AI Native
Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.
### Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo
At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we **take extreme ownership** of our work, **move with focus and urgency**, and **learn voraciously** to stay ahead.
We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to **own your role and make a real impact**. Collaboration is at our core—we’re **all for one**, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage **bold ideas and courageous action**, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.
If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

## **THE OPPORTUNITY**
We are building Watcher, a coding agent security product. Watcher is deployed in production and monitors billions of agent tokens per month across engineering teams at agent-building scale-ups and multinational enterprises.
We are hiring our founding Account Executive. You will own the full sales cycle end to end and build the playbook the rest of the GTM team runs on.
Our best conversations often start from a high-value interaction: an introduction from an investor, advisor or customer, a conference panel, a roundtable, the security communities our buyers already belong to, or the credibility of our research. A large part of this job is creating more of these. The other part is targeted outbound into groups where we have something specific to offer.
### KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
#### **Create the way in**
* Map target accounts to identify decision-makers, organizational structures, current pain points, and existing connections.
* Identify warm introduction paths via investors, advisors, clients, partners, and networks, then brief connectors and draft messaging to ensure successful connections.
* Capitalize on key engagement opportunities, such as speaking panels, hosted roundtables, buyer communities, and embedded partners.
* Execute highly targeted outbound campaigns focused on specific buyer segments, proven solutions, and relevant triggers rather than high volume.
#### **Own the sales cycle end to end**
* Run discovery, demos, and technical evaluations with security and engineering leaders.
* Scope and drive proofs of concept (POCs): establish success metrics up front, maintain pilot momentum, and drive conversion.
* Build compelling commercial and ROI cases to secure executive-level investment.
* Own commercial negotiation, security review, procurement and close in sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving senior business, technology, R&D, procurement, legal and executive decision-makers
#### **Build the playbook and hiring the team**
* Write down what works. Qualification criteria, discovery questions, POC structure, pricing guidance, objection handling, security questionnaire answers.
* Build and own the CRM; report on pipeline health, conversion, and what's working well enough to double down on
* Define what we need to hire next, and help to hire it.
#### **Product and market insights**
* Bring honest signals back about why deals progress or stall.
* Work with the product team on positioning, pricing, and the collateral enterprise buyers actually ask for.
### REPRESENTATIVE PROJECTS
* **Open an account cold.** Pick a target we currently have no route into. Map it, find the warmest path through our network, create the reason for the first conversation, and run it all the way to a scoped pilot.
* **Compress the cycle.** Enterprise evaluations in this market routinely take longer than they need to. Take the process apart, work out where the time actually goes, and rebuild it so an evaluation reaches a decision faster.
* **Land a lighthouse enterprise.** Take a large, slow, security-conscious organisation from first conversation through technical evaluation, security review and procurement to a production contract, and turn the process into a documented path the next one can follow.
* **Write the playbook.** By the time we add the next two people to this team, the thing that gets them productive in a month rather than six should be something you wrote.
### JOB REQUIREMENTS
#### **Must-haves**
* **You have closed enterprise deals as an individual contributor for 5+ years.**
* **You have sold at an early-stage company, before it had a machine.** You have 2+ years in a startup without mature marketing, an SDR team or brand recognition doing the work for you.
* **You have closed into large, slow organisations.** Our pipeline includes banks, quant funds and government bodies. You have personally run deals through security review, architecture review and procurement, and you have a realistic sense of how long that takes and how to compress it.
* **Technical credibility with a technical buyer.** Our buyers are directors of product security, principal security engineers and engineering leaders. You need to run discovery and a technical evaluation with them without a sales engineer in the room, understand the architecture well enough to be useful, and know when to bring in someone deeper.
* **High agency and ownership.** You decide where the quarter goes, you make the call with incomplete information, and you are accountable for the outcome. Nobody here will be assigning you a territory or a target list.
* **Startup pace.** Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and willing to grind when it matters.
* **Comfortable leveraging AI heavily** for research, drafting and deal work, while holding the output to a high standard.
#### **Strong nice-to-haves**
* **You have sold security, developer tools, or infrastructure**
* **Experience with coding agents as a user.** You have used Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar heavily.
* **Familiarity with how security teams evaluate vendors,** from either side of the table.
#### **Explicitly not required**
* **Formal AI safety background.** We need an excellent seller who can learn the AI safety context, and we will teach you what you need to know.
* **Management experience.** This starts as an individual contributor role.
### BENEFITS
* This role offers market competitive salary, equity, and competitive benefits.
* Base Salary: **£85,000 - £129,000;** Variable: performance incentives against ARR targets
* Everyone at Apollo effectively has an unlimited token budget. If a better result costs more compute, use it.
* Flexible work hours and schedule
* Unlimited vacation
* Unlimited sick leave
* Up to 6 months of paid parental leave
* Comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance
* Retirement savings with competitive employer matching
* Lunch, dinner, and snacks are provided for all employees on workdays
* Paid work trips, including staff retreats, business trips, and relevant conferences
* A yearly $1,000 (USD) professional development budget
* Relocation support and visa fees (if applicable)

* **Visa sponsorship:** We sponsor visas in the UK. Sponsorship isn't guaranteed for every role or candidate, but if we make you an offer, we'll work with you to find the right visa route.

You will work directly with Kyle Dai, our GTM lead, and alongside the product team: product engineers Jeremy Neiman, Zak Walters, Zen van Riel, Srdjan Miletic and Gustavo Bicalho; and control and security researchers Victor Gillioz, Monika Jotautaitė, Dmitrii Volkov and Billy Gigurtsis. The rapid rise in AI capabilities offers tremendous opportunities, but also presents significant risks. At Apollo Research, we're primarily concerned with risks from Loss of Control, i.e. risks coming from the model itself rather than e.g. humans misusing the AI. We're particularly concerned with deceptive alignment / scheming, a phenomenon where a model appears to be aligned but is, in fact, misaligned and capable of evading human oversight.

Our goal is to reduce the probability of catastrophic incidents by securing coding agents, learning about their real-world risks, and publishing our research on how to build these control systems most effectively.

* Work out which companies are deploying coding agents at scale, who inside them feels the problem, and which of them we should spend time on.
* Research accounts and people. Work out whether we have something genuinely useful for this person and what it is.
* Personalize the outreach. Short, specific, honest messages that a busy security engineer will reply to.
* Run outbound as a set of experiments rather than a volume target: test segments, messages, and channels against each other, read the results honestly, and kill what is not working.
#### **Events and conferences**
* Own the conference motion end to end. Decide which events are worth attending. Attendee research and prioritisation, pre-show outreach, booked meetings before the doors open, logistics on the day, and follow-up out within 48 hours.
* Make the team effective in the room: briefs on who is coming, what they care about, and what we want out of each conversation.
#### **Pipeline operations and tooling**
* Maintain best-in-class CRM hygiene: accurate notes, activity logging, dispositions, and next actions. Everyone has visibility where every live opportunity stands and what it is waiting on.
* Build the reporting that tells us what the top of the funnel is actually producing
* Turn repeated manual work into tooling. A good chunk of this job should be automating the previous version of this job.
### REPRESENTATIVE PROJECTS
* **Own a conference end to end.** Take a sponsored conference: Work the attendee list, research and rank who is genuinely worth our time, run the pre-show outreach, land a target number of booked meetings before day one, and have every follow-up sent within 48 hours of the close. Then write up which parts of that were worth repeating.
* **Make how we approach a new account repeatable.** Turn the way we research and open a company into something anyone here could run
* **Find the segment nobody has looked at.** Pick a slice of the market we have not worked on, build the list from scratch, write the messages, run it, and come back with a clear read on whether it is real.
### JOB REQUIREMENTS
#### **Must-haves**
* 2+ years of professional experience in a commercial, sales, go-to-market, or business development role
* **Early-stage experience.** You have worked at a startup without a playbook, ideally as one of the first commercial people there, and you know what it is like to decide what to do next rather than be told.
* **High agency and ownership.** You see what needs doing and do it. When something stalls, you find out why and move it, rather than reporting that it is stalled. You should want the responsibility of deciding where our effort goes, not just executing a list.
* **Startup pace.** Excited by a fast-moving environment, comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities, and willing to grind when it matters.
* **Technically curious.** You do not need to code, but you do need to get genuinely interested in how coding agents work and how they fail, well enough to hold a credible conversation with a security engineer and know when to hand off to someone deeper.
* **Comfortable leveraging AI heavily** for research, drafting and operations, while holding the output to a high standard.
#### **Strong nice-to-haves**
* **Background in cyber security, developer tools, or AI/ML**
* **Experience in founder-led sales.** You have supported a founder or a first GTM hire directly and understand how that relationship works.
* **Experience with coding agents as a user.** You have used Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar heavily.
* **Comfort with GTM tooling and light scripting.** CRM, enrichment, outbound tooling, or anything you have built yourself to avoid doing something twice.
#### **Explicitly not required**
* **Formal AI safety background.** We need an excellent operator who can learn the AI safety context, and we will teach you what you need to know.
### BENEFITS
* This role offers market competitive salary, equity, and competitive benefits.
* Base Salary: **£72,000 - £98,000;** Variable: performance incentives against ARR targets
* Everyone at Apollo effectively has an unlimited token budget. If a better result costs more compute, use it.
* Flexible work hours and schedule
* Unlimited vacation
* Unlimited sick leave

* Comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance

* **Location:** This is an in-person role working out of our London office, with regular travel to conferences and occasional travel to customer sites. We offer flexible working hours and some WFH arrangements.
* **Visa sponsorship:** We sponsor visas in the UK. Sponsorship isn't guaranteed for every role or candidate, but if we make you an offer, we'll work with you to find the right visa route.
## **ABOUT THE TEAM**
You will work directly with Kyle Dai, our GTM lead, and alongside the product team: product engineers Jeremy Neiman, Zak Walters, Zen van Riel, Srdjan Miletic and Gustavo Bicalho; and control and security researchers Victor Gillioz, Monika Jotautaitė, Dmitrii Volkov and Billy Gigurtsis. Marius Hobbhahn (CEO) advises the team. You will also interact with our other SWEs and researchers, since we intend to be "our own customer" by using our products internally for our research work. You can find our full team here.

The rapid rise in AI capabilities offers tremendous opportunities, but also presents significant risks. At Apollo Research, we're primarily concerned with risks from Loss of Control, i.e. risks coming from the model itself rather than e.g. humans misusing the AI. We're particularly concerned with deceptive alignment / scheming, a phenomenon where a model appears to be aligned but is, in fact, misaligned and capable of evading human oversight.
We work on the science of scheming, detection of scheming (e.g. building evaluations), and scheming mitigations (e.g. anti-scheming). # Manager, Customer Product Support - EMEA
#### Dublin
Apply
Our Customer Support team helps customers find clarity in their work and get results with Asana. We are Asana experts and productivity savants who are passionate about investing in our customers’ success. We help customers with questions, feature requests, and bug reports, and educate them about best practices. Within the organization, we amplify our customers’ voices in product development, and we encourage that dialogue through our support channels. We measure our success by our customers’ success, and we get there by exemplifying empathy with our customers.
In this role, you will support the operational execution and scaling of Asana’s global Customer Product Support organization. Reporting to the Head of Customer Product Support, you will lead and mentor a team of Individual Contributors (ICs) based in Dublin, partnering closely with our existing EMEA manager to provide dual leadership across the region. You will drive operational excellence across complex product cases, ensure team performance and KPI attainment, and surface structured insights to shape product and process improvements. As a hands-on leader, you will foster a coaching culture that balances customer advocacy with business priorities while modeling proactive, timely communication across cross-functional teams.
This role is based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
**What you’ll achieve**
* Partner seamlessly with the existing EMEA manager to provide operational leadership, coaching, and mentorship to strengthen technical expertise across the Dublin support team.
* Own and drive team-wide operational KPIs (including CSAT, response and resolution times, and backlog management) through process discipline and high standards of ownership.
* Serve as an escalation point for high-visibility customer issues, coordinating clear, timely resolution paths with internal stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Engineering.
* Proactively surface product issues and customer pain points to senior Support Leadership using data, storytelling, and business impact framing.
* Provide input on resource allocation and support ad-hoc operational projects to mature and scale the support organization.
* Foster an accountable, transparent team culture grounded in clear expectations, open communication, and alignment with Asana’s Operating Principles.
**About you**
* Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
* 6+ years of experience in customer support or services within a SaaS environment, including 3+ years of direct people leadership experience.
* Proven track record of coaching and developing individual contributors to achieve operational excellence and team KPIs.
* Strong technical acumen with demonstrated experience navigating complex SaaS product issues and escalations with clarity and professionalism.
* Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to represent Customer Support as a trusted business partner.
* Analytical and data-driven mindset with experience leveraging metrics and tools to identify trends, mitigate risks, and drive continuous process improvements.
At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
For this role, the estimated base salary range is between €77,000 - €97,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.
In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

* Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
* Career coaching & support
* Inclusive family building benefits

* In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences
