Ensure engineering processes, standards, and governance frameworks are consistently applied, delivering predictable, high-quality, and compliant outcomes. Champion innovation and the adoption of new technologies that improve design effectiveness, asset performance, and delivery outcomes. Take full responsibility for all design delivery processes for all asset types. This includes scheduling, execution, and completion of these activities (such as defining ITP and H&S file requirements, incorporating environmental and third-party obligations and risk elimination into designs, signing certificates), their timescales and quality, while leading on process improvements and efficiencies to deliver more effectively on site.
**People Leadership & Organisational Development**
1. 1. Lead, inspire, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering organisation, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Drive employee engagement, talent development, succession planning, and retention strategies to build a sustainable and future-ready engineering capability.

Monitor expenditure, resource utilisation, productivity, and commercial outcomes to ensure delivery remains within agreed financial parameters. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, enhance value, and optimise investment decisions while balancing operational, customer, and business objectives. Drive corrective actions where required and support the achievement of wider business performance targets.

**REQUIRED**

* Strong leadership skills and experience managing a team, preferably within a matrix organisation.

We value each and every one’s contribution as this builds our culture and means that if you work with us, you will be included, listened to, and respected.

Our commercial arrangements include a Lifecycle Renewals Framework operating under a bespoke Cost Plus Contract, alongside a Call-Off Framework (COFA) for National Highways-funded improvement schemes, primarily delivered through NEC3/NEC4 contractual arrangements. We place strong emphasis on effective supply chain management, commercial transparency and collaborative working, fostering relationships that drive innovation, manage risk, optimise delivery performance and deliver sustainable value for money across our investment portfolios.

## Job Description
**Could you be the technical expert who shapes how our solar and battery storage projects connect to the grid, guiding critical engineering decisions from early feasibility through to energisation?** We're looking for a Senior HV Engineer to join our Elgin's Engineering team as the in-house technical authority for grid connection and HV engineering across our utility-scale solar PV and co-located BESS projects in the UK and Ireland, with the potential to support Elgin's projects in Italy. The role follows the project lifecycle: grid feasibility and connection optioneering, development-stage engineering to support consents, land and grid applications, technical specification for procurement, and technical assurance of the contractors' design, construction and energisation. Elgin does not carry out detailed design in-house; detailed design and construction are delivered by ICP, iDNO and EPC contractors against Elgin's Employer's Requirements. The focus of the role is engineering and de-risking from the earliest stage of a project: bringing the grid engineering into development so that the connection method, cable route and substation requirements are settled through the feasibility work, planning applications, land agreements and grid applications rather than discovered later; making sure each connection is technically deliverable and that the contestable / non-contestable scope split is right before it is fixed in budgets and contracts; and assuring that the designs produced by ICPs, iDNOs and consultants meet Elgin's Employer's Requirements and the network operator's standards. Commercial and programme management of the DNO / TSO relationship sits outside of this role; this role provides the engineering judgement behind it. Elgin does not design or build its projects itself: it sets the technical requirements and its contractors deliver against them. The value of this role is in setting those requirements well and in challenging what consultants and contractors deliver. You will be the technical escalation and decision on HV and grid matters and the primary technical contact for Elgin's development-stage consultants and ICPs.
**What you will do:** **Development stage** * Lead the technical side of connection method and grid route optioneering for Development: scope and direct the feasibility studies, judge overhead line, underground cable and hybrid options on constructability, consentability, land take and cost, and recommend the option to take forward.
* Get the grid engineering into the development case early, so that it is reflected in consents and land rather than discovered at procurement: define the substation footprint, cable route corridor and crossing strategy for planning applications and consents, provide the technical input to land, wayleave and easement discussions, and prepare the technical inputs to grid connection and modification applications (DNO / NESO in GB, ESB Networks / EirGrid in Ireland).
* Produce concept-level single line diagrams, substation layouts and route corridors with the CAD team, to the level needed for feasibility, planning and tender purposes only; detailed design sits with the ICP, iDNO and EPC contractors. Discharge Elgin's CDM 2015 designer duties for the concept designs it produces.
* Act as primary technical contact for Elgin's development-stage consultants on cable routes, HV design and power system studies: define technical scopes, review deliverables and challenge conclusions before they enter project decisions. This is development-stage consultancy; detailed design is delivered by the EPC and ICP contractors.
* Specify and review the cable modelling, ampacity and losses studies (MV through 132 kV, and 220 kV in Ireland) carried out by consultants and contractors, and make sure the results feed the design basis, CAPEX and energy yield assumptions.
* Set and challenge the technical grid CAPEX assumptions and the engineering basis of the connection programme as they enter the investment case, and produce the technical reports, planning inputs and position papers that stand up to Investment Committee and lender scrutiny.
**Grid connection** * Technically interpret connection offers, Connection Agreements and technical schedules, on Elgin's own projects and in acquisition due diligence: what they commit Elgin to, where the contestable / non-contestable boundary sits, and the omissions, abnormal costs and onerous conditions behind them.
* Review and challenge network study outputs (fault level, harmonics, reactive capability, protection) and turn them into Employer's Requirements and contestable / non-contestable scope decisions for the ICP and EPC turnkey contracts.
* Own the contestable / non-contestable / Contractor interface on each project: define and record the scope split and close gaps and duplication between DNO, iDNO, ICP and EPC scopes before they become variations.
* Ensure the G99 / Grid Code compliance obligations in the Connection Agreement are allocated between the ICP and EPC scopes in the ERs and DoR, and own Elgin's technical compliance position with the network operator as the connection customer; lead any derogation application on Elgin's behalf, and witness compliance testing where required.
**Procurement and contracts support** * Author and maintain the HV and grid sections of Elgin's Employer's Requirements and Division of Responsibilities matrix, and support Procurement through ICP, iDNO and EPC tendering, evaluation and technical negotiation.
**Construction, commissioning and energisation (assurance and escalation)** * Assure the contractors' HV and grid design rather than produce it: make sure ICP, iDNO and EPC design submissions are reviewed against Elgin's Employer's Requirements and the network operator's standards (through the Owner's Engineer where one is appointed), decide Elgin's position on deviations with a reasoned justification, and close out Owner's Engineer comments.
* Act as Elgin's technical escalation point for the Project Engineers, the Owner's Engineer and the PMA through construction, commissioning and energisation: decide Elgin's response where site works deviate from design intent or the Connection Agreement, review the contractors' Grid Code compliance and energisation submissions before they go to the network operator, and attend key witness tests. Day-to-day technical queries and routine witnessing sit with the Owner's Engineer and the contractors.
**Ongoing** * Maintain Elgin's HV and grid engineering standards, templates and lessons learned, keep abreast of DNO / TSO standards and policy change.
## Your profile
* BEng / MEng in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems or a related discipline.
* Extensive HV and grid connection engineering experience (MV through 132 kV), including delivered UK utility-scale solar, BESS or ICP / DNO connection projects through to energisation.
* Detailed working knowledge of the GB connection process: G99, Connection Agreements and technical schedules, contestable and non-contestable works, the ICP and iDNO model, DNO design approval and adoption, and derogations.
* Experience of development-stage grid work: connection and modification applications, connection offer assessment, connection method and route optioneering, and technical inputs to planning applications and land agreements.
* Ability to read and challenge network study outputs and translate them into design and scope decisions.
* Strong HV design review capability: switchgear and protection, earthing, HV cables and routes, HDD and crossings, substations and transformers, metering, auxiliary supplies, SCADA / telecoms.
* Experience authoring or reviewing Employer's Requirements and Division of Responsibilities under EPC and ICP contracts, and scoping and challenging external consultants.
* Ability to translate technical decisions into CAPEX, programme and risk implications and communicate them clearly, in writing and in person, to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to specify, review and challenge cable modelling, ampacity and losses studies and power system studies, with working familiarity with AutoCAD and power system analysis tools.
* Full driving licence and willingness to travel to project sites in the UK and Ireland as required.
**Desirable** * Chartered Engineer (CEng) or working towards chartership.
* Irish connection experience (ESB Networks / EirGrid, CRU policy, ECP and RESS delivery) and transmission-level (110 kV to 220 kV) experience.
* BESS and co-located hybrid connections, including Grid Code compliance for storage.
* Power system modelling (DIgSILENT PowerFactory, ETAP or PSCAD); technical due diligence for acquisitions or lenders; CDM 2015 designer duties.

* Health, Medical Science & Generative Biology
* Food Security & Sustainable Agriculture
* Climate Change & Managing CO[2]

**Welcome to the Generative Biology Institute:**
Led by Founding Director Jason Chin, the Generative Biology Institute (GBI) at the Ellison Institute of Technology is tackling the key challenges in making biology engineerable, and thereby unlocking the unrivalled power of biology for the benefit of humanity.
The vision of the GBI is to lay the foundations for engineering biology, and unlock its potential for good. To achieve this, we must overcome two key challenges. First, we need the ability to write in the natural language of biology, enabling the rapid and scalable synthesis of entire genomes with precision. Second, we must understand what to write - determining which DNA sequences will generate biological systems that perform the desired functions. Addressing these challenges will allow us to harness the full power of biology to create transformative solutions across health, agriculture, clean energy and more.
GBI will have sustained and substantial funding to support the unique scale and ambition of its ground-breaking vision for engineering biology. GBI researchers will also be supported by cutting-edge technology hubs including mass spectrometry, flow cytometry, sequencing, automation, imaging, and bioprocessing. GBI will also have access to substantial compute resources that can be leveraged to further accelerate progress, including scientific compute, bioinformatics, and machine learning. The environment at GBI will allow researchers to undertake ambitious, long-term, collaborative research, and we will actively support the translation of research to commercial applications, where appropriate.
The Generative Biology Institute commenced operations in 2025, occupying newly renovated bespoke space in the Oxford Science Park. The team will later move to a purpose-made facility in the Oxford Science Park, currently under construction. Once complete, this state-of-the-art facility will include more than 40,000 m^2 of research laboratory and office space. It will house over 30 groups and up to 600 employees at scale, focused on solving the two critical challenges in making biology engineerable and applying the solutions to addressing the global challenges encapsulated in EIT's Humane Endeavors.
**Your Role:**
The Mass Spectrometry Tech Hub within the GBI is seeking a Scientist / Senior Scientist with expertise in single-cell mass spectrometry, with a particular focus on single-cell proteomics and/or metabolomics.
This is an exciting opportunity to help establish and develop cutting-edge single-cell MS workflows within a highly collaborative, technology-driven research institute. The successful candidate will work closely with GBI research groups as well as scientists across other EIT institutes. We also work in close collaboration with other Tech Hubs including automation, flow cytometry, sequencing, bioinformatics, scientific computing and AI/ML, to deliver high-quality, reproducible and scalable analytical workflows.
We are looking for candidates with a good understanding of the challenges of low-input and single-cell analysis, that can communicate clearly with multidisciplinary teams, can develop robust experimental workflows, and are motivated to push the boundaries of what mass spectrometry can deliver.
This role is particularly suited to a scientist who enjoys developing new methods, troubleshooting complex analytical workflows, working across biological applications, and translating advanced MS technologies into accessible, high-impact research capability for the wider Institute.
**Key Responsibilities**
* To develop, implement and optimise LC-MS-based workflows for low-input and single-cell proteomics and/or metabolomics.
* To support GBI, and broader EIT, researchers in the design, execution, analysis and interpretation of mass spectrometry experiments, including sample preparation, method development, data acquisition and data interpretation.
* To help develop standard operating procedures, training material and user-facing guidance for single-cell and low-input MS workflows.
* To contribute to the analysis and interpretation of complex MS datasets, working closely with bioinformatics, scientific computing and AI/ML colleagues where appropriate.
* To assist, where required, in manuscript preparation, internal reports and external presentations.
* To promote and champion EIT and the work of the GBI, representing the Institute at scientific meetings, conferences and public events where appropriate.
## Requirements
**Essential Criteria**
* PhD, equivalent advanced degree, or equivalent research/industry experience in analytical chemistry, mass spectrometry, proteomics, metabolomics, biochemistry, molecular biology, cell biology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in mass spectrometry-based proteomics and/or metabolomics, including LC-MS sample preparation, method development, data acquisition, troubleshooting and quality control.
* Strong knowledge of low-input or single-cell analytical workflows, including single-cell proteomics, single-cell metabolomics, low-cell-number proteomics or other high-sensitivity MS approaches.
* Practical understanding of bottom-up and top-down proteomics and/or metabolomics workflows, including LC-MS acquisition strategies, database searching, quantitative analysis and interpretation of complex datasets.
* Experience with MS data analysis software such as Spectronaut, DIA-NN, MaxQuant, Proteome Discoverer, FragPipe, Compound Discoverer, MS-DIAL, Skyline or equivalent platforms.
* Strong communication, collaboration and organisational skills, with a commitment to experimental reproducibility, data integrity and working effectively across multidisciplinary research teams.
**Desirable Experience**
* Hands-on experience with advanced high-resolution MS platforms, including Orbitrap Tribrid instruments and/or timsTOF platforms.
* Experience with nanoLC, low-flow LC, high-sensitivity chromatography, carrier proteome approaches, TMT/isobaric labelling, DIA, DDA, PRM, SRM/MRM or related quantitative MS workflows.
* Experience developing or implementing single-cell or ultra-low-input workflows such as nanoPOTS, SCoPE-MS, plexDIA, low-input DIA, FACS-based sample preparation or automated nanolitre-scale sample preparation.
* Experience working with limited or complex biological samples, including rare cell populations, sorted cells, micro-dissected material, primary cells, tissue-derived samples, organoids, microbial systems, plant samples or engineered biological systems.
* Experience integrating MS workflows with upstream biological or automation platforms, including cell culture, cell sorting, liquid handlers, acoustic dispensing, microfluidics or high-throughput sample preparation.
* Experience working in a technology hub, core facility, collaborative research environment, biotech, pharma or translational setting; for Senior Scientist level, evidence of independent method development,

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.
Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.
**About the Position** The Lead Energy Market Analyst – SPP & WECC will work directly with prospective and existing clients to increase sales and deliver technical pre-sales work across the SPP and WECC footprints. Working side by side with Account Directors and Regional VP of Sales, the analyst identifies the customer use cases where PLEXOS, Aurora, and Adapt2 create measurable value, proves that value in demonstrations, proofs of concept and pilot studies built on the customer's own market, and helps shape the regional go-to-market strategy. The analyst is the company's recognized subject matter expert on SPP and Western market design, resource adequacy, transmission planning and price formation. That expertise shows up three ways: in the room with customers, in published thought leadership that draws new prospects to Energy Exemplar, and in the feedback loop to Product that keeps the platforms ahead of market change. This is a senior individual-contributor role with wide latitude. The analyst owns the technical narrative for SPP and WECC pursuits, mentors less experienced analysts on the team, and is accountable, with Sales, for pipeline progression and technical win rate in the region. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain energy market models with a focus on the Southwest Power Pool (SPP) and Western Electricity Coordinating Council (WECC) regions, leveraging PLEXOS to analyze market dynamics, transmission constraints, generation dispatch, and regulatory developments while providing technical expertise and modeling solutions to prospective and existing customers.
* Translate customer business problems (resource adequacy filings, IRPs, RFP evaluation, interconnection economics, trading strategy, transmission justification) into modeling workflows and a clear commercial value story.
* Design and deliver tailored demonstrations, workshops, executive briefings and proofs of concept built in the customer's own market, converting them into new-logo and expansion opportunities.
* Own the technical content of proposals, RFP and RFI responses and statements of work for the region, coordinating input from Product, Services and Legal.
* Deepen existing accounts by identifying adjacent use cases, new user groups and cross-sell paths (PLEXOS to Aurora, planning to trading, simulation to AI Studio).
* Build, configure and validate PLEXOS and Aurora models for SPP and WECC: nodal and zonal topologies, generation and storage fleets, fuel and hydro assumptions, load and large-load forecasts, and market rules.
* Execute production cost, capacity expansion, resource adequacy and ELCC, LMP and congestion, storage valuation, transmission benefit and interconnection studies, and present results with commercial takeaways.
* Maintain the team's regional reference models and input libraries, benchmarked against published ISO, WECC and utility results, with documented workflows that Services can inherit.
* Showcase PLEXOS Intelligence capabilities (scenario automation, backtesting and calibration, results interpretation) on regional use cases.
* Identify and prioritize SPP and WECC use cases by segment, size the opportunity, and co-develop the regional go-to-market plan, target accounts, messaging and competitive positioning with Sales and Marketing.
* Create reusable demonstration assets, playbooks and enablement content so the wider Americas team can sell confidently into SPP and WECC.
* Serve as Energy Exemplar's public voice on SPP and Western market topics through white papers, webinars and presentations at SPP, WECC, CAISO, WPTF, NWPPA, WSPP and industry conferences.
* Monitor FERC orders, SPP and CAISO market design changes, WRAP and Markets+ milestones, state dockets and competitor activity, and brief Sales, Product and customers on the implications.
* Channel structured customer requirements to Product, coordinate with post-sales Services on handoffs and renewal signals, and mentor Solutions analysts in market knowledge, modeling practice and customer-facing skills.
**Candidate Requirements** * 7+ years in wholesale electricity markets, power system planning, energy economics or energy consulting, with at least 3 years focused on SPP, the Western Interconnection or both.
* Hands-on experience building and running production cost, capacity expansion or resource adequacy models in PLEXOS or Aurora, or in comparable tools with a demonstrated ability to learn new platforms quickly.
* Working command of SPP and Western market design: day-ahead and real-time clearing, ancillary services, LMP and congestion, capacity accreditation, planning reserve margins, WRAP and state RA constructs, transmission planning processes and interconnection.
* Proven customer-facing experience in pre-sales, consulting or client advisory, including scoping engagements, presenting to senior and executive audiences and managing competing stakeholder interests.
* Ability to turn complex quantitative results into a crisp commercial story: what the number means, why it matters to the customer's decision and what to do next.
* Strong data skills: Python or R, SQL and advanced Excel; comfort with large ISO, EIA, FERC and WECC datasets and with building repeatable data pipelines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; experience producing publication-quality reports, slides and webinar content.
* Self-directed and organized; able to run several concurrent pursuits with Sales and deliver on committed timelines.
**Qualifications** * Master's degree in electrical engineering, energy or environmental economics, applied mathematics, operations research, data science, public policy or a closely related field; equivalent professional experience considered.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license, CFA or Energy Risk Professional (ERP) designation.
* PLEXOS or Aurora certification, or completion of Energy Exemplar's advanced training programs.
* Active membership in IEEE PES, IAEE, USAEE or similar professional bodies.

job_description:
## Our Company
At EOS, we bring people, ideas and expertise together to deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers. Our success is built on collaboration, accountability and a shared commitment to continuous improvement.
We value people who are curious, organised and motivated to make a positive impact. By joining EOS, you will work in a collaborative environment where your contribution is recognised and where you can continue to develop your skills and career.
## Position Overview
We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented **Sales Operations Specialist** to serve as the operational backbone of our sales organisation.
In this role, you will connect Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Product teams to streamline sales processes, maintain CRM integrity, and deliver actionable reporting and analysis.
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels at cross-functional coordination and can translate complex or raw data into clear performance insights for sales leaders and executive stakeholders.
## Key Responsibilities
### Sales Coordination and Process Optimisation
* Act as the primary operational liaison for the regional sales team, supporting day-to-day logistics, responding to process enquiries and helping resolve workflow bottlenecks.
* Coordinate cross-functional processes across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, including deal handovers, contract routing and invoicing dependencies.
* Maintain and optimise CRM workflows using platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot, ensuring data integrity, accurate deal stages and effective lead routing.
* Support sales onboarding by coordinating training schedules, compiling enablement resources and tracking ramp-up timelines.
* Facilitate weekly and monthly sales meetings, coordinate agendas, document decisions and follow up on agreed actions.
* Identify process inefficiencies and support the development of clear, consistent and repeatable standard operating procedures.
### Reporting, Data and Analytics
* Build, maintain and automate recurring sales-performance dashboards and operational tracking reports.
* Monitor key sales metrics and KPIs, including pipeline velocity, win/loss ratios, quota attainment, average deal size and sales-cycle duration.
* Conduct weekly pipeline reviews to support forecasting accuracy and identify risks across sales stages.
* Produce ad hoc analytical reports for executive leadership to inform strategic decision-making, forecasting and territory planning.
* Conduct regular data audits to remove duplicate records, correct missing or inaccurate entries and maintain effective database hygiene.
* Translate complex data into concise visual reports, summaries and recommendations for frontline sales teams and leadership.
## Qualifications and Requirements
### Experience
* **2-4 years of experience** in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations or a closely related coordination role.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects or operational processes involving multiple departments and competing priorities.
### Systems and Tools
* Hands-on experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, PivotTables and data visualisation.
* Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Tableau, Microsoft Power BI or Looker is desirable.
### Core Competencies
* **Exceptional coordination:** A demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional projects, maintain momentum and align stakeholders with different priorities.
* **Analytical thinking:** The ability to interpret complex data and convert it into meaningful executive-level reports, visualisations and recommendations.
* **Clear communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor information for frontline sales representatives, cross-functional partners and senior leaders.
* **Process orientation:** A proactive approach to identifying inefficiencies and creating clear, repeatable and scalable processes.
* **Attention to detail:** A consistent focus on accuracy, data quality and effective follow-through.
* **Adaptability:** The ability to prioritise effectively and respond constructively to changing business needs in a fast-paced environment.
## Belonging at EOS
At EOS, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to contribute fully. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, perspectives, identities and experiences.

**Every pay day matters - and this role is at the heart of creating a positive, reliable experience for our people.**

With support from your colleagues, you will manage the end-to-end monthly payroll cycle, ensuring every pay run is completed on time, accurately, and in line with UK statutory requirements. * **Oversee the monthly payroll lifecycle:** Manage and support the full payroll cycles for approximately 1900 UK employees overall, ensuring accurate and timely monthly processing.

# Manager - Microsoft Agent Builder - TC - FS

## Job description
Requisition ID: 1718097
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
# The opportunity
This is a hands-on delivery role for a Manager who designs, builds and deploys Microsoft AI and agentic solutions for financial services clients. The role owns delivery workstreams from design and use-case decomposition through configuration, build, integration, testing, pilot, deployment and adoption, working to the target architecture agreed with technical architecture.
The Manager will work with business leads, product owners, technology, data, security, risk, compliance and change teams. They will translate business processes and control requirements into working agent, automation and data designs, make practical platform and configuration decisions within the agreed architecture, and explain those decisions in plain language to business stakeholders.
The role requires current hands-on depth across Microsoft Copilot and agent technologies, the Power Platform, and the identity, data and governance services that make them safe in a regulated estate. It also requires the judgement to select the right boundary between Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Cowork, Autopilots and Power Platform, and to recognise when a use case needs Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service or custom Azure components and should be escalated for architectural design.
Strong relationships with Microsoft teams are important. The Manager will work day to day with the Microsoft Account team, Specialist Team Unit (STU) sellers and Global Black Belt (GBB) specialists to confirm platform fit, unblock technical issues, and support co-sell and co-build activity, solution showcases and follow-on pipeline growth.
# Your key responsibilities
## Solution design and use-case engineering
* Lead discovery across business journeys, processes, applications, data sources, integration touchpoints, entitlements and control requirements.
* Produce problem statements, design principles, future-state journeys, process maps, solution designs, agent specifications and role or operating-model impacts.
* Decompose prioritised use cases into agents, topics, tools, actions, workflows, connectors, knowledge sources, human approval points and operational controls.
* Recommend and justify platform choices across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Cowork, Autopilots and Power Platform, and escalate to solution architecture where a use case needs Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service or custom Azure components.
* Prioritise use cases on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and complexity, and build the business case across financial, customer, operational and risk outcomes.
* Define MVP scope, sequencing, release plans, non-functional expectations and the adoption approach that goes with them.
## Build, integration and data
* Design, build and test custom Cowork, Autopilot, Copilot Studio agents, including topics, knowledge sources, actions, tools, triggers, channels, connectors and orchestration behaviour.
* Build Power Platform solutions across Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI and Dataverse, applying environment strategy, solution packaging and application lifecycle management.
* Integrate agents and automations with systems of record using certified and custom connectors, Microsoft Graph, Dataverse and REST APIs, working within rate limits, shared service accounts and legacy interfaces, and escalating where no usable API exists.
* Configure governed grounding and retrieval over SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Fabric and curated data products, managing retrieval scope, permissions trimming, data freshness and provenance.
* Implement approval, write-back and reconciliation controls for actions that update systems of record, including rejection and resumption paths.
* Design agent behaviour that fails safely, covering fallback responses, escalation to a human, and clear handling of out-of-scope or low-confidence requests.
## Security, governance and responsible AI
* Build to secure-by-design and responsible-AI standards, covering identity propagation, least privilege, environment separation, secrets handling and correct connector and data scope.
* Working with our Cyber team, apply Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Purview controls to the solutions you build, including sensitivity labelling, data loss prevention, auditability and retention.
* Build human-in-the-loop checkpoints before client-facing activity, credit or risk decisions, and writes to systems of record, with evidence captured at each step.
* Configure logging and traceability for prompts, retrieved context, tool calls, model outputs, approvals, actions and exceptions.
* Prepare solution evidence for security, privacy, model-risk and compliance review, and take design and control approvals through to a decision.
## Delivery, testing and production readiness
* Lead delivery workstreams that move designs into prototypes, proofs of concept, MVPs, pilots and scaled production services.
* Set up development environments, source control, solution packaging and the deployment pipeline that moves agentic solutions safely from sandbox to enterprise production.
* Test non-deterministic systems using golden datasets, prompt and tool-selection regression, adversarial and prompt-injection testing, sampled human review, and regular playbacks and demos.
* Run user acceptance, performance and operational-readiness testing, and agree monitoring, alerting, licensing, capacity, cost management and the support model at handover.
* Write and assure requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, controls and adoption plans.
* Manage technical risks, dependencies, issues, scope changes and delivery quality, and keep the team focused on measurable business outcomes and tracked benefits.
## Team leadership, adoption and Microsoft ecosystem
* Act as the day-to-day delivery lead for client stakeholders and present designs, progress and technical decisions to steering groups, design authorities and decision forums.
* Lead small teams of consultants, analysts, AI engineers and low-code developers, coach junior colleagues and set the standard for build and review quality.
* Drive adoption and enablement through training, live builds, demos, champion networks and practical governance guidance, so solutions are used rather than only delivered.
* Build strong day-to-day relationships with Microsoft Account, STU specialist seller and GBB technical teams, and bring them in early to confirm platform fit and unblock technical issues.
* Align solutions to Microsoft priority workloads and reference architectures, and contribute to joint account planning, client briefings, demonstrations, proposals and solution showcases.
* Manage engagement scope, budget, quality and timelines, and support proposals, pitches and follow-on work.
# # Skills and attributes for success
* Strong hands-on delivery experience building AI, agentic, automation or low-code solutions, ideally in consulting and regulated financial services.
* Proven track record taking solutions end to end, from design through build and testing to a working product in production use.
* Ability to explain a solution design end to end, including agent behaviour, data flows, identity, controls, approval points and failure paths.
* Ability to distinguish between Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform and pro-code solutions based on requirements rather than preference, and to know when to escalate to architecture.
* Experience delivering against imperfect enterprise estates, including legacy APIs, batch feeds, inconsistent entitlements and systems with no consumable API.
* Experience working within architecture governance, security review and responsible-AI controls, and preparing the evidence those forums require.
* Strong workshop facilitation, stakeholder management and client-facing communication, including presenting and demonstrating in plain language.
* Experience leading small delivery teams and working in agile, product-based or hybrid delivery environments.
# To qualify for the role
* Experience in consulting, technology or business transformation, ideally including financial services.
* Demonstrable hands-on build and delivery experience across multiple technologies listed in the Technology experience required section, in particular Copilot Studio and the Power Platform.
* Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems of record and governed data sources.
* Practical working knowledge of identity, data access, security, privacy, audit, responsible AI, GDPR and AI governance expectations.
* Experience building MVPs, pilots and proofs of concept, and moving agentic solutions safely from sandbox to enterprise production.
* Experience running client workshops, managing stakeholders and presenting to steering groups or design authorities.
* Experience working with Microsoft teams or partner ecosystem motions, including technical validation, co-sell, co-build or joint propositions.
* Degree-level education in any discipline. Microsoft certifications across the Microsoft stack are welcomed.
# The following will be an advantage
* Microsoft certifications such as Copilot Studio agent enablement, PL-900, AI-900, DP-900, AZ-900 or Power Platform developer credentials.
* Experience with additional process automation and analytics tooling, or with design thinking and innovation-strategy methods.
* Experience in banking, insurance, wealth management, asset management, capital markets, payments, risk, compliance, finance or operations technology.
# What we look for
We are looking for a credible builder who can move quickly from a use case to a working solution, make explicit technology choices within an agreed architecture, expose risks and assumptions early, and stay close enough to the client to make sure what is built is actually adopted. The successful candidate will treat integration, identity, grounding, human approval, testing and auditability as core build activities, not later delivery concerns.

# Finance Manager Job Description
##### The purpose of the post
The Finance Manager is responsible for the effective day-to-day management and operation of the organisation’s finance function, working closely with the Head of Finance to ensure that financial information is accurate, timely and robust.
The Finance Manager will oversee the finance team and the organisation’s core financial processes, maintain effective financial controls and ensure that accounting records, reconciliations, payments, income, payroll and statutory financial requirements are completed accurately and on time.
The role will provide the Head of Finance with accurate and timely financial information, analysis and supporting schedules to enable effective management of the organisation’s finances, including management accounts, budgeting, forecasting and financial decision-making.
##### Terms & Conditions
**Job Title:** Finance Manager **Reporting to:** Head of Finance **Responsible for:** Finance Officer, Finance Assistant **Hours:** 39 hours per week **Salary:** £34,739 – £38,065 depending on experience **Holidays:** 32 days (inc. statutory holidays) per annum
##### Key Duties & Responsibilities
**1. Financial Operations & Team Management**
* Lead the day-to-day operation of the finance function, ensuring financial transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.
* Manage and support the finance team, setting priorities and fostering a positive, collaborative working environment.
* Maintain effective financial controls, procedures and processes, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and compliance.
* Support the ongoing development of finance systems and reporting tools.
**2. Financial Reporting & Management Information**
* Support the preparation of management accounts, budgets and forecasts, providing analysis and insight to aid decision-making.
* Produce regular financial information to budget holders and support them in understanding financial performance.
* Investigate and explain key financial variances and emerging issues.
**3. Financial Accounting & Compliance**
* Oversee balance sheet reconciliations and ensure the integrity of financial records across the organisation.
* Support the preparation of year-end statutory accounts, and external audit process.
* Ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards, charity regulations and internal financial policies.
**4. Grants, Funds & Income Management**
* Support the financial management and reporting of grants, restricted funds and fundraising activity.
* Ensure income is accurately recorded, allocated and reconciled in accordance with organisational and funder requirements.
* Oversee Gift Aid administration and claims process.
**5. Payroll, Tax & Treasury**
* Oversee payroll and pension processes, ensuring all payments, submissions and reconciliations are completed accurately and on time.
* Manage VAT compliance and support specialist tax-related activities, including Theatre Tax Relief claims where applicable.
* Oversee payment processes, banking activities and cash management arrangements.
**6. Wider Organisational Support**
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation to support operational planning and continuous improvement.

**Role Purpose**
This is a new, global role created to own our guest retention and repeat booking rates. As a member of the Global Marketing Team this role will have full accountability for repeat enquiry generation. Operating at the intersection of data, tech and brand to ensure every guest interaction is personalised, timely and on-brand. This role is both strategic and hands-on and will suit someone who is commercially minded and takes pride in developing solutions and the quality of execution. Working across the full Scott Dunn portfolio; our main brand, the ultra-high-net-worth Scott Dunn Private proposition and the UK family-focused Scott Dunn Explorers offering, understanding where guest needs differ and how we need to address this within our customer interactions. This role is both strategic and hands-on: you will set the retention strategy and then work across Guest Loyalty, Marketing, Sales and Guest Relations to coordinate its implementation, holding each team to account for their part in the guest experience. You will also have dotted-line oversight of the Scott Dunn Private CRM & Marketing Executive to ensure retention activity for our UHNW guests is joined up with the wider strategy.
**Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Guest Journey**
* Map the end-to-end guest journey after first booking; pre-departure, during travel and post-return, across Scott Dunn, Scott Dunn Private and Scott Dunn Explorers, identifying every touchpoint where we as a brand interact with our guests, in each of our markets.

* Work with the regional marketing managers and brand team to determine the most suitable gifts
* Own gift sourcing, managing the budget and organising their distribution to guests working with the operations teams.
**Stakeholder Coordination & Delivery**
* Be the champion of the guest journey within the business, ensuring that the needs of our previous guests are always factored into new decision making and educating cross-functionally on what those needs are
* Partner with the US, UK and Asia Senior Marketing Managers to ensure the retention strategy reflects market-specific guest behaviour and is embedded into local marketing planning.
* Work with our Business Analyst team to thoroughly understand our guest data, calculate KPIs and set up reports for this.
* Coordinate implementation of the retention strategy across the various functions within the Marketing team, the Guest Loyalty teams, Sales and Customer Service holding each team to account for their part in the post-booking guest experience.
* Equip guest-facing teams; Travel Specialists, Guest Loyalty and Guest Relations with the skills and guidance to deliver a consistently strong retention experience, in partnership with the relevant team leads.
* Provide dotted-line direction to the Scott Dunn Private CRM & Marketing Executive, ensuring UHNW guest retention activity is joined up with the global strategy.
* Shape the design of guest loyalty programme mechanics and rewards, partnering with Guest Loyalty on delivery and iterating based on results.
* Translate strategy into a clear brief for the Marketing channel teams (email, content, digital) and Guest Loyalty teams who own execution and track that delivery lands as intended.
**Data, Insight, & Governance**
* Be the overarching owner of guest data within the business, ensuring access to and use of the data is entirely appropriate and necessary.
* Working within our bespoke CRM system collaborate with the tech and data teams to extract rich guest data into a usable format to inform personalisation opportunities.
* Distribute contact lists as needed, segmenting so that only necessary data is shared, for email, digital personalisation, direct mail sends, reach-out activations and so on.
* Use booking, engagement and NPS data to proactively identify guests at risk of not rebooking and direct the relevant teams to intervene before they lapse.
* Work with technology teams to develop tech-first solutions that streamline this process.
* Champion the development of a single, unified view of the guest across Scott Dunn's brands and markets, working with data and technology teams to ensure guest data can be reliably segmented and personalised against.
* Ensure guest interactions with Travel Specialists, concierge and the contact centre are captured back into the guest data view, not just booking-system data.
* Establish an ongoing feedback loop — voice-of-guest research, NPS, journey experiments — to continuously test and refine the post-booking experience rather than treating it as a one-off fix.
* Build the business case for retention investment and present findings, roadmap and progress to senior leadership.
* Ensure guest data is used for retention activity in a way that is fully compliant with data protection regulations across the UK, US, Singapore and Hong Kong.
**Responsibilities**
* 2+ years’ proven experience in a strategic CRM, guest experience, retention or loyalty role, ideally within a luxury brand.
* 5+ years’ experience in consumer marketing, preferably in a luxury environment.
* A genuine understanding of the luxury and high-net-worth consumer — what drives their loyalty and what erodes it.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior peers and cross-functional teams without formal authority over most of them.
* Strong hands-on capability with CRM platforms: comfortable working within bespoke or technically complex systems.
* Demonstrated expertise in segmentation strategy, lifecycle marketing and data-led personalisation.
* Demonstrated expertise in using analytical tools such as GA4 and PowerBI alongside CRM platforms.
* Experience managing or dotted-line directing a team member, ideally within CRM or marketing.
* Experience owning or contributing to a marketing budget, with sound commercial judgement on prioritising investment.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, comfortable presenting strategy and business cases to senior leadership.
* Strong analytical skills, able to translate guest data (NPS, surveys, booking behaviour) into a clear narrative and action plan and present findings with clarity.
* Experience mapping or redesigning customer/guest journeys, ideally across multiple brands or segments.
* Comfortable partnering with data and technology teams to define the guest data foundation needed for segmentation and personalisation, even without owning technical delivery.
* Working knowledge of data protection principles across international markets (e.g. UK GDPR and equivalent regimes in the US, Singapore and Hong Kong) as they apply to guest data and marketing communications.
* Comfortable operating in a global, matrixed organisation spanning UK, US and Asia.
* Self-directed and comfortable building a new function from first principles.
* Passion for travel and a natural affinity with what makes a luxury guest experience feel considered and personal, never generic.
**Values & Behaviours**
All employees must promote, understand, and apply Scott Dunn’s workplace values. These are embedded in all roles and applicants must evidence the values as part of the application process.
* In the know - Start by listening. We take the time to understand our guests’ and colleagues needs. Be Precise. We take pride in getting every detail right. Own it. We deliver on commitments we make.

In return for your expertise and commitment to our values of in the detail, in the know, and inspiring;
* We support your career growth – We provide you with career progression aligned with your chosen career path, access to internal job opportunities across Scott Dunn's global offices, as well as across 30+ brands spread across 93 cities worldwide as part of Flight Centre Travel Group
* We give you the tools to succeed – We provide personal and professional development enabled by our award-winning Learning and Development team, comprehensive familiarisation, and educational trips, unlimited access to LinkedIn learning amongst other professional and personal development platforms, as well as 1 hour for your own development each week.
* We recognise and reward your success and loyalty – We run commission and bonus incentive schemes to compliment competitive salaries, as well as a company loyalty scheme, which includes a personal travel fund for each staff member and 23 days annual leave plus bank holidays that rises by 1 day per each year of service (up to a maximum of 30).
* We celebrate your excellence – With monthly, quarterly, and annual recognition schemes and awards, alongside the opportunity to win a place at Flight Centre Travel Groups annual Global Gathering, we celebrate excellence in all forms.
* We provide you with a wide-range of job and industry-perks – We can offer you subsidized private healthcare, a contributory pension scheme, staff travel insurance, 3 days of paid volunteering leave, access to cycle to work and season ticket loan schemes, a dedicated in-house team who are your source for exclusive industry discounts for personal and work-related travel, as well as share options in Flight Centre Travel Group amongst much, much, more!
**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

As part of our commitment to diversity, equality, and inclusion we are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is inclusive and recognises the value of differences.

This is not monitoring from a distance. At Fortrea Clinical Pharmacology Services in Leeds, CRAs are on site, in the flow of the study, when it matters most.

We are committed to creating opportunities for talent by being inclusive in all that we do.

This role champions the creative use of AI across Fremantle’s international development and production teams. You’ll spend time with territories and labels, finding out what they are exploring and creating, spotting promising ideas and connecting people who can build on each other’s work. Reporting to the Global Head of Entertainment and working closely with central AI colleagues, you’ll bring local insights back to the centre and share developments, learning and creative wins internationally to drive creative AI content development.

Territory engagement and discovery

* Get out to meet teams, including territory visits where appropriate, to discover promising ideas, experiments and approaches, and understand where support or connections would help.
* Maintain regular contact with local teams to keep up with new developments, learning and successes.
International connections and creative collaboration
* Connect colleagues who are exploring similar ideas or have complementary experience, making introductions that help them learn from each other and collaborate.
* Champion opportunities for creative AI content development by bringing relevant examples, ideas and collaborators to territory teams.
* Help teams build on successful local work and explore approaches suited to their own productions, with local teams owning creative decisions and delivery.
Territory insights and international updates
* Bring developments, insights, needs and creative wins back to the Global Head of Entertainment and central AI colleagues to inform discussions and priorities.
* Share clear, useful updates and case studies across international teams, highlighting what others can learn from local work and where there may be opportunities to collaborate.

* Organise demonstrations, spotlighting events and knowledge-sharing sessions that give visibility to creative work and inspire teams to explore new ideas.
* Build engaging presentation decks and lead presentations at summits and other international forums, showcasing AI tools and their practical applications in creative content development and production.

* Significant experience in television, film or media development or production, with a strong understanding of how creative ideas become content.

* Highly proactive and comfortable getting out to meet teams, asking questions and finding out what is happening across the business.
* Strong listening skills and creative judgement, with the ability to recognise promising work, draw out useful insights and connect people with relevant experience.

* Confidence bringing communities together and facilitating discussions, demonstrations and creative exchanges across teams.
* Sound commercial judgement and an understanding of production realities, including the potential benefits and limitations of AI.
* A collaborative, adaptable approach, with the ability to work through relationships and influence while respecting local priorities and ownership.

## Company Description
Genomics England is a global leader in enabling genomic medicine and research, focused on creating a world where everyone benefits from genomic healthcare. **Platform Engineer - AWS Cloud Platform Team** Are you a Platform Engineer who is passionate about automation, AWS cloud technology, and solving complex engineering challenges?
At Genomics England, we're hiring a Core Level Platform Engineer to help design, build and optimise our AWS cloud platform using modern automation and infrastructure tooling.
This role sits in our high impact Cloud Platform Team within our Scalable Tech business service; the team currently consists of 6 to 7 Cloud Platform Engineers and forms part of our Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE). We own and operate the AWS Organisation and Landing Zone and are responsible for designing, implementing and promoting cloud best practices across our 100+ in house engineering community. * Support the wider organisation in cloud adoption by building reusable platform components, templates, and standards that accelerate application team delivery while maintaining platform consistency.

* Troubleshoot and debug platform issues, ensuring seamless operations and minimal downtime.
* Influence engineering decisions in a collaborative and inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives.

* Minimum 2 years' experience as a Platform Engineer, Cloud Engineer or similar role within a DevOps environment.
* A minimum of 2 years' commercial experience with AWS. Relevant certifications would be an advantage.

* Familiarity with automation tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.
* Desirable experience working within an organisation with a Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE).
* Understanding of cloud governance principles, including cost optimisation, tagging strategies, and security best practices in multi-account AWS environments.
* An interest in enabling and mentoring application teams in cloud best practices, promoting a self-service model while maintaining architectural and operational standards.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, particularly GitLab CI/CD, and DevOps best practices.
* Proficiency in scripting, including Python, alongside Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices to automate deployments, optimise infrastructure and support CI/CD pipelines.
**If you have at least 2 years’ solid commercial experience as a Platform Engineer, building and improving complex cloud platforms, and you're passionate about AWS, automation and engineering best practice, we'd love to hear from you. * Qualifications are not mandatory. However, AWS, Terraform or automation certifications are welcomed and would be considered an advantage.

# Head of Finance
## Take full ownership of Geomiq's finance function, strengthen reporting and controls across four countries, and partner the CEO on the decisions that shape our next stage of growth.
**Location:** London (Hybrid – 4 days per week in office) **Employment:** Full-time, permanent **Reports to:** CEO
### About Geomiq
Geomiq is a fast-growing digital manufacturing company transforming how businesses source custom-manufactured components.
We combine technology with a global manufacturing network to deliver industry leading service levels for manufactured goods.
We have operations across the UK, China, India and Portugal, and we're entering an exciting phase of growth.
We're looking for a commercially minded **Head of Finance** to take full ownership of our finance function, strengthen financial reporting and help shape our next stage of development.
### The Opportunity
This is a hands-on leadership role with genuine ownership and direct exposure to the CEO and leadership team.
You'll lead an existing finance team of two, take responsibility for financial performance and controls for future growth.
We're looking for someone who goes beyond producing accurate accounts — someone who uses financial information to improve decisions, challenge assumptions and drive business performance.
### Key Responsibilities
**Financial Management & Reporting**
* Own monthly management accounts, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow and group consolidation.
* Deliver accurate financial reporting, budgets and forecasts.
* Maintain robust financial controls, reconciliations and accounting policies.
* Oversee statutory compliance, audits and relationships with external advisers.
**Commercial Finance & Strategy**
* Partner directly with the CEO and leadership team on financial decisions.
* Analyse profitability, margins, working capital and cash conversion.
* Evaluate hiring plans, investments and growth opportunities through financial modelling.
* Proactively identify risks, opportunities and areas to improve financial performance.
**Auditing & Financial Due Diligence**
* Prepare and maintain financial information for audits.
* Coordinate financial information requests from investors and advisers.
**International Finance**
* Oversee financial reporting and governance across our UK, China, India and Portugal operations.
* Work with local teams and advisers to ensure financial accuracy and compliance.
* Establish consistent financial reporting and controls across the group.
**Systems, Automation & Team Leadership**
* Lead and develop our existing finance team.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual financial processes and improve efficiency.
* Work with our technology team to improve reporting, systems integration and data quality.
* Champion the responsible use of AI and automation within finance.
* Build scalable financial processes that support continued business growth.
### What We're Looking For
**Essential:**
* Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or equivalent relevant experience.
* Significant experience as a Financial Controller, Group Financial Controller, Head of Finance or similar.
* Strong technical accounting, financial reporting and cash flow management skills.
* Commercial mindset, with the confidence to challenge senior leadership.
* Experience managing a finance team and improving financial processes.
* Ability to operate independently and take full ownership of the finance function.
**Desirable:**
* Experience supporting investment rounds, auditing or financial due diligence.
* International group reporting and consolidation experience.
* Background in high growth businesses.
* Experience with financial systems, automation and data-driven reporting.
* Experience working directly with CEOs, boards or investors.
### What Success Looks Like
**First 90 days:** Take ownership of financial reporting, establish strong controls, improve cash flow visibility and identify opportunities to strengthen finance operations.
**Within six months:** Deliver accurate, timely and commercially useful reporting, establish robust due diligence readiness and become a trusted financial partner to the CEO and leadership team.
### Why Join Geomiq?
* **Ownership:** Lead the finance function with real autonomy and responsibility.
* **Impact:** Work directly with the CEO on decisions that shape the business.
* **Growth:** Join an ambitious international company with significant growth opportunities.
* **Technology:** Help build an efficient, automated and scalable finance function.
* **Progression:** Opportunity to develop towards Finance Director as the company grows.
**We're looking for someone who combines the financial discipline of an excellent Financial Controller with the commercial judgement and ambition of a future Finance Director.**

### **The Role**
We're hiring Product Designers to help shape how enterprises understand, govern, and trust their AI agents.
Geordie is building category-defining tooling for agent visibility, governance, and risk. The design challenge is real: AI agent behaviour is complex, often opaque, and the stakes for our customers are high.
Our design team is small today; you'll report into our Head of Product Design and join two Product Designers. We have three development teams, growing to five, and we believe design works best embedded. You'll join one of those teams as its designer, working alongside its engineers and customers every day. Because we're still early, you'll also help set the foundation everything else is built on: the design language, the component library, and the patterns we use across the product. Our design team also looks after Geordie's brand, so you'll help shape how we show up beyond the product too, making sure brand and product feel like one coherent experience.
Design here isn't a layer applied at the end. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. We don't have Product Managers; design and engineering partner directly to figure out what to build. Our engineers are deeply product-minded, close to customers, and want to solve the right problem rather than ship to spec. Together you'll define problems, shape scope, and own outcomes. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.
We also move fast. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.
### **What You'll Do**
Own the end-to-end design of core product experiences, from early concept through to shipped and iterated.
Help build Geordie's design system with the rest of the design team; the tokens, components, patterns, and documentation that everyone relies on, shaped by what your team needs.
Contribute to Geordie's brand; helping evolve our visual language, illustration, and assets so the product and brand tell one story.
Lead customer discovery and research; running interviews, identifying patterns, and bringing customer insight into every design decision.
Work directly with customers to test your thinking early and close the loop between insight and shipped product.
Collaborate daily with engineers; pairing, reviewing, and increasingly using AI tools to prototype and contribute to the codebase yourself.
Contribute to product direction: you will be in the room where decisions are made, not handed a spec to execute.
Keep a strong point of view on what good design looks like in a security and governance product; clear, trustworthy, and built for expert users.
### **What We're Looking For**
The most important thing is that you care deeply about customers and can move fast without losing quality. You are a strong practitioner; you can go from whiteboard to high-fidelity quickly, and you know when each is appropriate.
You are comfortable with ambiguity. We are Series A, the product is evolving, and the domain of AI agent governance is genuinely new. You find that energising, not unsettling.
You have strong opinions about design systems and component architecture, and experience building or significantly contributing to one. You can articulate why decisions were made and defend them clearly.
You work well in a collaborative engineering culture. You are comfortable pair-designing with engineers, reviewing pull requests for design quality, and using AI tools to accelerate your own work.
### **Requirements**
Significant experience as a product designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates complex UX problem-solving; not just polished visuals.
Experience designing highly complex B2B SaaS products, including data visualisation and data-dense interfaces; you can turn large volumes of information into something expert users can understand and act on.
Proven ability to work across the full design process: research, concept, detailed design, and handoff.
Strong product thinking; you can define the problem, question the brief, and help decide what to build, not just how it should look.
Strong communication and collaboration skills; you can align stakeholders, present work with clarity, and receive feedback well.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, iterative environment where requirements evolve quickly.
### **Nice to Haves**
Experience designing for security, developer, or enterprise SaaS products.
Familiarity with AI agent tooling, observability platforms, or data-dense interfaces.
Experience contributing to a design system, including tokens, components, and documentation.
Experience working on brand or visual identity, such as illustration, iconography, or marketing design.
Experience writing code, even basic frontend, or using AI tools to prototype in the browser.
Background working at an early-stage startup where you built things from scratch.
### **Why This Role**
AI agents are changing how companies operate, and the question of how to govern them safely is only going to grow. Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to answer that question.
You will join at a point where design is still being defined. There is no legacy system to work around, no established playbook to follow; just a hard problem, a sharp team, and a genuine opportunity to shape how a new category is understood.
You will work with real customers, see the impact of your work quickly, and have the scope to grow as the company does.
### **Our Values**
**Solve What Matters**
We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.
**Build, Learn, Iterate**
We favour momentum over perfection; testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.
**Kind, Not Comfortable**
We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.
**A Platform for Your Best Work**
We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

**About Us**
Our Children’s Homes are operational and provide a range of support shaped around the individual needs of children and young people. This includes support for younger children who may need a period of intensive care, with the aim of helping them return to a family setting where appropriate, as well as longer-term residential care for young people who need stability and continuity. As occupancy grows, we are continuing to strengthen our teams, embed consistently high standards of practice and develop the service in line with the changing needs of the children we care for.
All our homes will offer a service to those children and young people for whom residential care is a placement of choice and assessed to be the most appropriate resource to enable them to fulfil their potential. # Simulation Content Designer (3 month contract)
United Kingdom
At Go1, we’re on a mission to enable companies to achieve the impossible by maximizing the potential of their people. From a small startup to a global brand - we’ve grown by solving hard problems, embracing ambiguity, and never standing still. If you thrive on change, get energy from big, complex challenges, and are excited to grow fast alongside smart, ambitious people, then Go1 might be exactly what you’re looking for. We offer autonomy with accountability, space to experiment, and the opportunity to shape solutions that impact millions of learners worldwide. We don’t have all the answers — and that’s the point. We figure it out together. Every line of code, every conversation, every bold idea helps move us closer to our mission: to enable individuals, organizations, and society to progress. There’s still so much to build — and even more to discover. **Go there with us...**
This role will help us explore how realistic simulations can make applied workplace capability more visible. Completing a course doesn’t always show how someone will respond when a real workplace situation gets difficult. Go1 is developing realistic workplace simulations to help organisations see how people apply their judgement in practice. We’re looking for a Simulation Content Designer to create the scenarios, conversations and assessment models at the centre of that experience. You’ll turn policies, obligations and capability needs into simulations that feel believable, assess behaviour fairly and give customers useful insight. This is a 3 month contractor role, you must be based in the UK.
This is a hands-on design role at the intersection of learning experience design, behavioural assessment and AI-powered product development. The capability is still emerging, so you’ll help work out what good looks like as well as produce the simulations themselves. You’ll partner with Product, Research, Engineering and subject-matter experts to shape simulations from the initial learning need through to testing and review. That means:
* Turning workplace policies, obligations and capability needs into realistic scenarios.
* Designing each simulation’s context, objective, relationships, conversation flow and outcomes.
* Defining behaviours that can be observed and assessed, including what different levels of performance look like.
* Building scoring rubrics that assess judgement fairly while allowing for reasonable differences in how people respond.
* Shaping avatar behaviour, including tone, resistance and emotional responses as a conversation develops.
* Running repeated spoken tests to find where a simulation breaks down or produces unreliable results.
* Diagnosing whether an issue sits in the scenario, learner context, rubric, avatar behaviour or product configuration.
* Working with Product and Research to clarify what each simulation should reveal about learner behaviour.
* Coordinating reviews with Legal, HR, cybersecurity and other subject-matter experts.
* Helping establish reusable design patterns and quality standards for future simulations.
* Communicating your design decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly.
**What you'll bring:**
You have experience in instructional design, learning experience design, scenario-based learning or behavioural assessment. You know how to make a workplace scenario feel plausible, and how to assess an open-ended response against clear, observable behaviours.
* Experience designing learning or assessment involving realistic workplace behaviour.
* Experience in compliance, HR, workplace conduct, cybersecurity or a related area.
* Strong scenario-writing skills and an ear for nuanced, believable dialogue.
* The ability to create scoring guidance that is clear, fair and useful.
* Confidence testing and refining spoken or conversational experiences.
* Sound judgement when reviewing AI-generated content and assessment guidance.
* The ability to work independently while staying closely connected to Product, Research, Engineering and subject-matter experts.
**Nice to haves:**
It would be helpful to have worked with simulations, role plays, immersive or conversational learning, AI-assisted learning or assessment products, LLM prompts, evaluation criteria or AI quality assurance. Experience in B2B SaaS, learning technology or enterprise product development is also useful.
You like solving the design problem behind the content: what should happen, what behaviour matters, and how can we tell whether the experience is working? You’re comfortable with the fact that an AI-powered simulation may sound convincing while still being unrealistic, unfair or difficult to assess. You’re willing to test, question and refine the work until it’s useful to learners and customers.

# Risk - AI Model Validation - Associate - Birmingham
Birmingham, West Midlands, England, United Kingdom
## Job Description
**About the Team**
Goldman Sachs's Model Risk Management (MRM) team plays a critical role in ensuring the safety and soundness of the firm's models. MRM validates a diverse set of models, including AI and machine learning models, used within the firm. This role offers the opportunity to significantly contributions to the firm's overall model risk management framework and AI.
**MODEL RISK MANAGEMENT (MRM)**
The Model Risk Management (MRM) group is a multidisciplinary group of quantitative experts at Goldman Sachs with presence in New York, Dallas, London, Birmingham, Warsaw, Hong Kong, and Bangalore. The MRM group is responsible for independent oversight of Model Risk at the firm, ensuring compliance with Firmwide Policy on Model Control and related standards, including documentation to evidence effective challenge over the Model development, implementation, and usage of Models.
The group’s primary mandate is to manage risk that arises from models used in the firm through its range of businesses– from models used for derivatives valuation to models used for risk management, liquidity and capital computations. In addition to independently reviewing these classes of models for their validity, theoretical consistency and implementation accuracy, the group is also responsible to assess the risk associated with model choice, e.g., exposure to choice of model in various contexts such as pricing exotic options or in calculating capital.
**Who We Look For** Goldman Sachs is seeking a highly motivated AI Model Risk Associate to join our Model Risk Management (MRM) team in Birmingham. You will play a crucial role in validating the firm's AI models, ensuring their accuracy, reliability, and compliance with regulatory requirements. This is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to a wide range of AI applications within a leading global financial institution and contribute directly to the firm's risk management framework. You will work closely with AI researchers, AI model developers, and other stakeholders to understand model methodologies, assess model risks, and implement validation plans and benchmarking models.
**Responsibilities**
* Independently validate the performance, accuracy, and reliability of AI models used within Goldman Sachs, focusing on aspects such as accuracy, explainability, model design, and algorithmic robustness.
* Develop and implement validation methodologies and benchmark models tailored to the specific characteristics of AI models.
* Conduct thorough testing and analysis of model outputs, identifying and documenting potential risks and limitations.
* Collaborate with model developers and business stakeholders to address identified issues and improve model performance.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* A Bachelor, Master or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative field.
* Programming expertise in Python, including experience with relevant data science libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, TensorFlow, Pytorch).
* Understanding of statistical modelling and machine learning algorithms
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to work in a collaborative environment.
