It helps mitigate risk, save lives, and make sure those affected by a crisis receive the support and compassion they need.
**One organisation, four brands**
Kenyon International is one of four TrustFlight brands. TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform, building the technology that helps aviation operate safely and stay compliant. Baines Simmons delivers aviation training and consulting, and Redline Assured Security delivers government-standard aviation security. Each brand keeps its own name, heritage and team. Together we share one platform, one set of values and one purpose: closing the gaps between disconnected tools and providers, because those gaps are where risk accumulates. Working at Kenyon means your readiness connects to the systems that help prevent incidents in the first place.
**Why people stay**
We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to do their job without too many rules and barriers getting in the way. Our culture is built on empowerment and trust: we hire good people and expect them to make the right calls for the company and the customer. Everyone has an individual training budget and protected development time, because transforming an industry means our people have to keep learning. Our offices in the UK, Canada, the US and Jersey are where teams meet to collaborate and plan, and we flex around each person's circumstances. People who deliver get more scope. Across TrustFlight, interns have become engineers, test engineers have become product managers, and coordinators have become team leads.
Our values guide how we work. Integrity: we are transparent and open, and we offer trust before we ask for it. Responsibility: we own our work and make it the best it can be. Innovation: we build for the industry's future needs, not just what exists today. Excellence: in everything we deliver.
**Why this role matters**
You will own the availability and readiness of Kenyon's response equipment, consumables and supply chain across the UK, Europe and Africa, including our mass fatality response infrastructure such as mortuary and DVI equipment and personal effects processing materials. You will play a key role in daily operations and in emergency response activations on behalf of the companies that retain Kenyon for emergency and disaster response services. When we are activated, you deploy the equipment and activate the supply chain; when equipment and supply chain are not in scope, you support the Crisis Management Centre.
**What you will do**
* Maintain the readiness of Kenyon's global equipment and resources for deployment.
* Establish and improve the supply chain underpinning Kenyon's operations, including identification, planning, analysis and pre-contracting of suppliers.
* Manage the warehouse and supplies, including inventory control and reporting.
* Source, specify and maintain Kenyon's mass fatality response equipment and consumables, such as temporary mortuary infrastructure, mortuary supplies, PPE, identification and DVI equipment, and personal effects processing materials, against Kenyon's standard operating procedures.
* Source, specify and maintain Kenyon's family assistance equipment in line with Kenyon's humanitarian business plan.
* Identify and promote new technical equipment to support supply chain delivery and incidents, including GPS beacons, handheld radios and communication systems.
* Prepare the shipping documentation for response consumables and equipment, including dangerous goods declarations, and check that documentation is correct and complete before despatch.
* Support health and safety functions, including weekly fire safety checks, regular evacuation drills, COSHH risk assessments, and other health and safety tasks as required.
* Provide equipment and supply chain input to the standard operating procedures and flag where a procedure no longer matches the equipment held or the supply chain provision in place.
* Maintain equipment, inventory and supplier records in Kenyon's internal systems, databases and spreadsheets, and report on stock levels, equipment status and supplier performance.
* Provide reciprocal cover for the Crisis Response Coordinator(s) / Operations Specialist(s) during absence.
* On activation, deploy or provision Kenyon's response equipment as the first call on this role: arrange its movement to the incident site, and support the deployed team with its set-up, operation, recovery and return to stock.
* Support the Crisis Management Centre during an activation, as directed.
* Deploy in various functions and roles of the Kenyon response model to support clients dealing with a crisis incident.
* Ensure that relevant legislation requirements are followed, including Health and Safety, aviation-related requirements (e.g. Family Assistance Law), and data protection.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement in the warehouse and supply chain and support their implementation, and provide equipment, inventory and supplier records to the Quality function on request in support of internal, client and certification audits.
* Attend sales presentations, conduct site visits and maintain regular communication with key personnel, delivering excellent customer service, and support commercial efforts during client visits with warehouse tours and presentation of equipment and supply chain capabilities.
* Handle recovered personal effects and the associated records in line with Kenyon's data protection obligations and client instructions.
* Such other duties as may reasonably be required from time to time, commensurate with the level of the role.
**What success looks like**
* Equipment and deployable kit readiness: the proportion of critical response inventory serviceable, in date and ready for deployment at any point in the year. Target 98%, with no critical line out of stock or out of date.
* Full physical stock check completed and reconciled against the equipment inventory record. Target: within the first 90 days in post, and annually thereafter.
* Mass fatality response equipment and consumables held against the documented kit specification and casualty planning assumptions, reviewed quarterly. Where that specification does not yet exist, it is documented and approved within the first six months in post.
* Supplier pre-contracting coverage against the response model: the proportion of critical equipment and consumable lines with a pre-agreed supplier and confirmed lead time. Target 90% by the end of year one.
* Monthly equipment maintenance checks completed. Target 100%.
* Shipping and dangerous goods documentation complete and accurate on despatch. Target 100%.
**How we work with AI**
TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation. Every role, from engineering to crisis response, uses AI tools in day-to-day work, and you will complete our AI onboarding in your first 30 days. In this role that means working as an AI Practitioner: designing prompts and workflows that use AI for analysis, reporting or automation, evaluating the quality and bias of AI output, identifying new AI use cases within Operations, and sharing best practice with the team.
**Where and how you will work**
* Working hours: No fixed hours apply to this role. Core availability is expected Monday to Friday during business hours across relevant time zones, but you will work whatever hours the role demands, which may include evenings, weekends, on-call coverage, and response to operational activations.
* Work pattern: Office and warehouse based at Bracknell, with hybrid flexibility agreed with your line manager.
* Travel: Willing and able to commit to domestic and international travel based on business activities, including occasional to regular and unrestricted travel and absence from home for up to 21 days at a time during incident deployments.
* On-call or shift work: Participation in the on-call rota / emergency activation lines.
* Screening or clearance: Pre-employment screening requirements such as BPSS.
* Special conditions: You will work routinely with mass fatality response equipment, consumables and recovered personal effects, and may be required to deploy to a mass fatality environment. Regular manual handling and warehouse duties.
**What we offer**

* Generous holiday allowance, plus your birthday off
* Company pension contribution
* Healthcare cover for everyone, including dental and optical
* A personal training allowance for conferences, professional bodies, courses and online resources
* Flexible working arranged with your manager

Click Apply and send us your CV and a short cover note on why this role and why Kenyon. We read every application and will contact candidates selected for interview.

Headquartered at the Harwell Campus in Oxfordshire, the NQCC works across government, industry, and academia to address the engineering challenges of scaling quantum computers and to build a quantum-ready economy. Its mission is to enable the UK to solve complex societal and industrial challenges by harnessing the transformative potential of quantum computing. The NQCC is a joint initiative of the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC) and the Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC). It sits alongside other departments within the STFC National Laboratories and has a 10-year funding commitment as part of the National Quantum Strategy **About the Role:** As a Senior Quantum Applications Engineer within the National Quantum Computing Centre’s Quantum Applications Team (QAT), you will provide technical leadership in the development of innovative quantum computing solutions to complex real-world challenges. Combining deep expertise in quantum computing with the ability to carry out independent research and delivery, you will drive the identification, development, and validation of high-impact applications, helping to shape research directions and advance the state-of-the-art across quantum algorithms, software, and hardware.
Working within a multidisciplinary environment of scientists, engineers, and technology specialists, you will lead collaborative research and development activities, mentor colleagues, and influence technical decision-making across programmes. Your work will contribute directly to the NQCC’s mission of accelerating the UK's quantum readiness, demonstrating quantum advantage where possible, and enabling the adoption of quantum technologies across key sectors.
The role offers significant opportunities to build and lead collaborations with stakeholders from government, industry, and academia. Through strategic partnerships, collaborative R&D programmes, and proof-of-concept projects, you will help define and evaluate future quantum computing use cases, translating emerging research into impactful solutions and strengthening the UK's quantum ecosystem.
**Key Responsibilities:** • Lead technical work and research to support the delivery of the team’s objectives. • Utilise and retailor quantum algorithms; build models and develop code; programme quantum computers using relevant Software Development Kits (SDKs) and programming environments; build the necessary mathematical models, libraries and codebases to underpin delivery of the technical work and research. • Promote collaboration with quantum algorithm, benchmarking, verification and error correction experts, to underpin and enable the delivery of useful applications. • Work with colleagues and external stakeholders to identify suitable problem types and develop use-cases for quantum computing relevant to priority sectors, such as life sciences, healthcare, finance, energy and transport. • Analyse quantum advantage for practical problems, using leading classical techniques that solve those problems as a benchmark. • Lead and deliver technical work on collaborative projects with colleagues and external stakeholders. • Adopt and further the use of agile and software engineering methodologies. • Lead the reporting and communicating of key findings and results, including the publication of non-confidential results in peer-reviewed journals. • Keep up with the state-of-the-art in quantum computing. • Contribute to the delivery of the NQCC’s strategic objectives and the UK’s delivery of Quantum Mission 1. • Provide technical advice and guidance to junior members of staff.
**Person Specification:**
This role is suitable for persons holding PhD qualifications or equivalent experience in quantum algorithms and applications development, physics or quantum technologies. A Senior Quantum Applications Engineer works well as part of a multidisciplinary team, but also demonstrates autonomy within their area of responsibility. You will be proactive, self-motivated and able to work in a dynamic environment. You will have a good eye for detail interpreting and presenting technical data. [S&I] • Strong and demonstrable experience in using classical programming languages, such as Python (as a minimum), as well as using programming languages and software development kits (SDKs – e.g., Qiskit, Cirq) to program quantum computers. The UKRI CIO Group plays a pivotal role in managing and optimising the organisations critical enterprise technical services that underpin and enable UKRI’s business capabilities. Within the group a team of Information Security Professionals support the delivery of modern, secure, resilient and scalable services across a larger federated team of Digital, Data and Technology professionals to deliver impact across the organisation and the wider UK research and innovation system.
This is a rare opportunity to be an enterprise lead for UKRI’s information security governance, risk and assurance at the heart of UK research and innovation. **Your responsibilities:**
* Be accountable for the effectiveness, coherence and continuing development of UKRI’s enterprise security governance, risk and assurance framework.
* Provide independent challenge and oversight of security risk, control design and control effectiveness, without assuming responsibility for operating the controls being assured.

* Ensure assurance coverage is risk-based, proportionate and consistent across UKRI’s federated environment, while maintaining clear accountability with local service, risk and control owners.

* Provide an authoritative, evidence-based enterprise view of security risk, control effectiveness, assurance gaps and remediation status to support informed senior decision-making.

Cyber criminals advertise fake job adverts with prestigious employers as a way of stealing information or even defrauding individuals out of money. ### **Description**
**Reports to:** Head of Finance
**Location:** United Kingdom
**Direct reports:** None
**Entities covered:** All legal entities across all portfolios of the group
**Frameworks:** Local GAAP per jurisdiction, IFRS for group purposes
**External parties:** Statutory and group auditors, local accounting and filing providers, company secretarial providers
### Role overview
The Statutory Reporting & Compliance Manager owns timely, accurate and audit-ready statutory reporting for every legal entity in the group, across all portfolios.
The role separates statutory compliance from the portfolio finance teams. They can focus on business performance, cash and portfolio priorities, while statutory deadlines and accounting judgements have a dedicated owner.
The role holder is the single point of accountability for statutory accounts, statutory audits, local GAAP to IFRS conversion and the group's compliance calendar.
### Reporting line
The role reports directly to the Head of Finance and sits outside the portfolio reporting lines. This protects statutory deadlines and accounting judgements from competing business priorities.
### Key responsibilities
**Statutory accounts**
• Prepare, or oversee preparation of, statutory financial statements for all legal entities under local GAAP.
• Own the group statutory and filing calendar, and make sure every filing deadline is met.
• Manage local accounting and filing providers where entities are serviced externally.
**Statutory and group audits**
• Plan and lead statutory audits end to end: timetable, PBC lists, audit files and closing meetings.
• Act as primary contact for statutory auditors, and coordinate support to the group auditor.
• Resolve audit findings and track management letter points to closure.
**IFRS and technical accounting**
• Deliver local GAAP to IFRS conversions and respond to IFRS reporting requests.
• Set group accounting policies and position papers, for example IFRS 15 revenue recognition, IFRS 16 leases, capitalised development costs and intercompany in close cooperation with the headquarter
• Support acquisition accounting for new deals, including opening balance sheets, purchase price allocation and alignment of acquired entities to group policies.
**Compliance and controls**
• Maintain the legal entity register from a finance perspective: filing status, auditors, year-ends and local requirements.
• Define minimum statutory standards that the portfolio teams' month-end must meet, for example balance sheet reconciliations and documentation.
• Coordinate responses to internal audit findings that relate to statutory reporting.
• Support entity rationalization, such as mergers and liquidations of dormant entities.
**Tax interface**
• Work with the Tax Manager on tax provisions, deferred tax and tax notes in the statutory accounts.
• Provide the financial data needed for transfer pricing documentation and local tax filings.
### **Interfaces and decision rights**
The portfolio teams keep running the books. This role owns what turns those books into compliant statutory output.
* **Portfolio Finance Directors:** They own portfolio results, priorities and staffing of entity teams. This role owns the statutory calendar, deliverable requirements and sign-off of statutory accounts.
* **Entity teams:** They own the monthly close, ledgers, reconciliations and audit support data. This role owns statutory adjustments, audit files and auditor communication.
* **Finance business partners:** They own management reporting, forecasts and KPIs. There is no overlap; this role informs them of audit adjustments affecting reported numbers.
* **Tax Manager:** They own tax computations, filings and transfer pricing policy. This role owns tax notes and balances in the statutory accounts.
* **Treasury:** They own cash, banking and financing. This role owns disclosures on cash, debt and covenants (if applicable).
* **External auditors:** They own the audit opinion. This role owns audit-ready files, the timetable and resolution of findings.
### Qualifications and experience
**Required**
• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA or equivalent).
• 7+ years in statutory reporting, including 3+ years in audit at a Big Four or mid-tier firm.
• Strong IFRS knowledge, especially IFRS 15 and IFRS 16
• Experience with statutory accounts and audits across several jurisdictions, including the US, Europe and APAC.
• Track record of running multiple statutory audits in parallel against fixed deadlines.
**Preferred**
• Experience in a multi-entity software, SaaS or buy-and-build group.
• Acquisition accounting and post-deal integration of acquired entities.
• NetSuite or a comparable multi-entity ERP.
• Experience managing outsourced accounting and filing providers.
**Skills and personal attributes**
• **Calendar discipline:** plans months ahead and treats filing deadlines as fixed.
• **Independence:** holds a technical position under business pressure and escalates early.
• **Influence without authority:** gets entity teams in other reporting lines to deliver on time.
• **Hands-on:** prepares accounts and audit files personally where needed; this is not a pure oversight role.
• **Clear communicator:** explains technical accounting to non-accountants, including investment partners and other senior management.
• **Builder:** creates templates, checklists and standards that make the next year's cycle faster. Leverages tools to automate tasks
• **Languages:** fluent English; additional European languages are a plus.
### **Success measures**
* **First 3 months:** Complete statutory and filing calendar for all entities, with owners and current status.
* **First 3 months:** Overdue filings and open audits identified, with 50% resolved.
* **First 6 months:** All statutory filings submitted on time, with no late-filing penalties.
* **First 12 months:** Statutory audits closed within agreed timetables; prior-year management letter points resolved.
* **First 12 months:** Portfolio finance teams’ time spent on statutory work cut by at least 50%.
* **First 14 months:** Automate at least 40% of the recurring preparation work for statutory audits.
* **Ongoing:** Newly acquired entities aligned to group policies and the calendar within 6 months of closing.

You'll join our web team, working alongside front-end engineers and our Software Engineer in Test, and reporting to the Lead Frontend Engineer. It's a team where curiosity meets craft: we blend creativity, technical excellence and a strong product mindset to create experiences that feel simple, rewarding and built to last.
## Why This Role Matters
**Why the role exists**
We're looking for a hands-on Frontend Software Engineer who can own front-end craft and extend it end to end - from the interfaces our customers use to the Cloudflare Workers and light backend services that power them.
This is an individual contributor role with plenty of influence. You'll build with React and TypeScript, work on API routes, integrations and edge logic using Cloudflare Workers, and help make AI-first, verify-second engineering the team's default.
You'll partner with the Lead Frontend Engineer on architecture, with Product and Design on user experience, and with our Software Engineer in Test on quality. You'll set direction through the quality of your code, reviews and judgement, rather than through formal authority.
We're looking for someone who asks why, not just what. You'll be curious about our customers and commercial goals, challenge assumptions constructively and help us spot valuable opportunities before they arrive as tickets. This is a UK-based hybrid role, including time with the team in Leeds, and may include occasional travel to our European and other international locations as we grow.
### **What success looks like**
* Ship polished, accessible and high-performing customer experiences built on strong React and TypeScript foundations.
* Deliver features end to end, including the Cloudflare Workers, APIs and integrations behind the interface.
* Use AI tooling as a genuine development partner while checking, testing and improving every output before it ships.
* Build quality in from the start through testable code, unit and component coverage, and close partnership with our Software Engineer in Test.
* Raise the technical bar for front-end craft, edge architecture and full-stack judgement across the web team.
* Turn customer and business insight into better product decisions, not just completed tickets.
# **What You’ll Do**
**Customer experience and front-end craft**
* Build and maintain customer-facing experiences. We currently use Astro and React, but prioritise selecting the right tool for each challenge over adherence to any single framework.
* Turn design intent into polished, resilient interfaces, partnering closely with Product and Design.
* Own responsive layouts, cross-browser compatibility and progressive enhancement across our brand portfolio.
* Build accessibility (WCAG), Core Web Vitals, component quality and sensible front-end caching into everyday engineering decisions.
**Full-stack and edge delivery**
* Deliver features end to end across our Cloudflare Workers stack—API routes, edge logic, integrations—using Wrangler, D1, KV and R2.
* Build and maintain integrations with forms, CRM and marketing tools such as HubSpot, and headless CMS platforms such as Storyblok.
* Make sound architectural decisions on the edge platform, leveraging Cloudflare's caching, KV and CDN to keep our infrastructure lean.
* Consider internationalisation and localisation as our products and edge logic adapt for different markets.
**AI-first, quality-first engineering**
* Use agentic AI tooling, including Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar, for scaffolding, refactoring, debugging and documentation.
* Treat AI output as a starting point: run type-checks and tests, verify API and library claims against official documentation, and keep human judgement around any meaningful risk.
* Write your own unit and component tests with Vitest, React Testing Library or similar, and partner with our Software Engineer in Test on end-to-end, visual regression and accessibility automation.
* Integrate work cleanly through Git, GitHub Actions and our Jira-based Agile workflow, contributing thoughtfully to planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
**Technical leadership and continuous improvement**
* Shape front-end and edge architecture through high-quality code, constructive reviews and mentoring by example, working with the Lead Frontend Engineer on strategic decisions.
* Improve the codebase and team workflows, staying current with the front-end and AI landscape and bringing back credible, proven ideas.
* Write clear, structured code and documentation that both people and AI agents can understand and work with.
## What You’ll Bring
## **Essential**
* Substantial hands-on experience as a front-end-focused full-stack engineer, with a track record of senior-level ownership. This is often built over five or more years, but depth and judgement matter more than an exact number.
* Strong, idiomatic React and confidence across the modern JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystem.
* A strong grasp of front-end craft, including UI and UX sensibility, responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, progressive enhancement and maintainable component architecture.
* Confidence extending into backend development through Cloudflare Workers or an equivalent edge or serverless platform, plus Node-based API services.
* Practical, regular use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, with good judgement about when to trust, verify or reject their output.
* Experience with a headless CMS such as Storyblok and third-party integrations, including forms and CRM or marketing platforms such as HubSpot.
* A working understanding of accessibility, Core Web Vitals and caching across the browser, CDN and edge as everyday engineering concerns.
* A habit of writing your own unit and component tests using Vitest, React Testing Library or similar, alongside effective collaboration with a dedicated quality function.
* Confidence with Git, Agile delivery and CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions.
* Sound architectural judgement, clear communication and the confidence to shape technical direction without formal authority.
* A proactive mindset: you investigate, ask why and propose better options rather than waiting for a ticket to define every next step.
## **Helpful**
* Experience with internationalisation or localisation in front-end or edge applications.
* Exposure to agentic AI workflows or MCP-based tooling, such as Playwright MCP or Storyblok MCP.
* Experience partnering with a QA or SDET function on end-to-end, visual regression or accessibility automation.
* Familiarity with performance testing tools such as Lighthouse or similar..
* A background in e-commerce or re-commerce platforms.
## **Qualifications**
No specific qualifications are required. We care about the work you've done, the judgement you bring and how you keep learning.
## Living Our Values
In this role, living our values means:
* Put the customer and the wider business outcome at the heart of technical decisions.
* Take ownership, follow through and care about the quality of what reaches production.
* Work openly with Engineering, Product, Design and Quality, sharing context and knowledge as you go.
* Stay curious, challenge assumptions constructively and keep learning as the technology landscape changes.
* Use sound judgement and integrity, especially when AI can move quickly but still needs thoughtful human verification.

Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. As Engineering Manager for Data Engineering, you will lead and grow the team responsible for the data foundations that support Virta’s business, care delivery, and AI capabilities. You will take over an established team with deep technical and business knowledge and help shape its next stage of growth. The team is composed of both Data Engineers (platform) and Analytics Engineers (models). You will be accountable for reliable pipelines, platform tooling, and engineering standards, as well as reusable analytical models, semantic definitions, and the Looker experiences that help people make decisions. Both disciplines are core to the role, with distinct skills and career paths to develop.
Your initial priorities will be completing our data and analytics modernization, expanding self-service, and enabling agents and ML to use trusted data. * **Own discovery, priorities, and delivery.** Build relationships with Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Commercial, and Clinical partners. Translate their needs into a focused roadmap, resolve competing priorities, and balance planned work with operational support.

* **Own analytics engineering quality.** Guide the development of reusable dbt models, shared semantic definitions, and LookML. Partner with domain experts to establish consistent business meaning and create datasets that serve multiple use cases.

* Experience leading a significant data platform or analytics migration, including data validation, stakeholder adoption, and operational continuity.

* Experience building data agents, governed natural-language analytics, semantic layers for AI, or data capabilities that support production ML systems.
* Experience introducing AI-assisted development workflows with effective testing and review practices.
* Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, including sensitive-data governance and access controls.

## Our mission
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason - the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...
## How you'll help us achieve it
We're looking for an experienced security engineer who's independent, excited about getting things done, and ready to hit the ground running. You'll primarily be responsible for our application security, working with our product teams to work on new systems to enhance our security posture. Our customers trust us with their money, and you'll be at the forefront of making sure we retain that trust!
This broadly scoped role will allow you to get your hands on many different types of security projects, from direct application security to helping our infrastructure team think about security for our databases.
As we integrate AI-powered agents into our engineering and operations workflows, you'll help define and enforce the guardrails around how we use them safely. This includes securing agentic tooling against prompt injection, excessive permissions, and data exfiltration - and building the policies and technical controls to govern AI usage across the company.
Some experience with common industry certifications like ISO-27001 and PCI-DSS would be beneficial, although you won't be expected to run or oversee audits.
Our to-do list changes constantly, but here are some recent projects:
* Design our agentic SIEM/SecOps pipelines to evaluate and tune AI-driven triage, alerting, and response automation
* Secure our MCP integrations against prompt injection, tool misuse, and credential exposure
* Tune and maintain code security review agents tailored to Wave's codebase, threat model, and regulatory environment
* Develop internal AI governance standards covering acceptable use, data handling, and audit requirements for LLM-powered tools
* Centralise application-level login and permissions enforcement including privileged access management
* Rework our approach to secrets management with ephemeral secrets and tighter access scopes
* Security review of our public-facing APIs

* You can work remotely from anywhere (between UTC -5 and +4) with reliable internet access.

# Head of Retail & Licensing
**Head of Retail & Licensing**
The Welsh Rugby Union is seeking a Head of Retail & Licensing to lead the next phase of its retail and merchandise strategy, creating new opportunities for commercial growth, product development and fan engagement.
This is an opportunity to shape how one of rugby's most recognised brands approaches retail, merchandise and licensing, developing its commercial potential across physical stores, e-commerce and partner-led channels.
Reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer, you will take ownership of the WRU's retail strategy, working with key partners to maximise revenue, improve profitability and develop new commercial opportunities.
**Location:** Principality Stadium, Cardiff **Working arrangements:** Primarily office-based, with some flexibility
**Closing Date:** 16 November 2026
**Salary:** £70,000 per annum, plus an annual bonus opportunity of up to 20% of base salary

You will lead the development and delivery of an ambitious retail strategy, identifying opportunities to increase revenue, improve profitability and maximise the commercial value of the WRU brand.
A central part of the role will be managing the WRU's retail operating partner, driving performance across physical stores, stadium retail, e-commerce and other channels. You will provide commercial direction and oversight, ensuring effective delivery across product ranges, pricing, stock availability and major events.
Working closely with the technical kit supplier and internal teams, you will help develop commercially successful merchandise ranges, coordinate product launches and identify opportunities to increase sales.

# Head of Talent Management and Insight
To lead the strategic delivery of Talent Insight and Management across Welsh rugby, establishing and embedding a clear and uniquely Welsh DNA for how players are unearthed, understood, connected and developed across the men’s and women’s performance systems.
The role is accountable for defining and delivering an integrated Player Intelligence System and national player pipeline, bringing together expert judgement, scouting, data science, AI and human factors to build a holistic and longitudinal understanding of player performance, potential and progression.
Through modern player trajectory modelling, agentic workflows and evidence-led decision-making, the role will continually improve Welsh rugby’s ability to identify, retain, develop and accelerate future international players, providing coaches and executive leaders with the intelligence to make better player and talent decisions.
**Salary:** **Competitive**
**Closing Date: 29th October 2026**
**The Person**
* Significant senior experience within elite sport, talent, performance intelligence, data science, player development or another relevant high-performance environment.
* Demonstrable experience of developing and implementing strategy across complex, multidisciplinary performance systems.
* Deep understanding of talent identification, talent development and player progression, including the complexity, uncertainty and non-linear nature of predicting future performance.
* Strong understanding of modern data science, predictive modelling and longitudinal player analysis, with the ability to translate technical approaches into meaningful performance questions and decisions.
* Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, automation and agentic systems, with the ability to identify where these technologies can transform scouting, intelligence and performance workflows.
* Excellent understanding of scouting, player assessment and expert judgement, and the ability to integrate qualitative and quantitative evidence rather than privileging either in isolation.
* Demonstrable ability to turn complex information into clear, decision-ready insight for coaches, performance leaders and senior executives.
* Strong understanding of evidence-led decision-making, including uncertainty, bias, validation, calibration and the limitations of predictive information.
* Experience of designing or improving player intelligence, talent management, data or performance systems that connect information across multiple environments
**The Role**
* Define, own and embed a world leading Talent Insight and Management strategy, creating a single longitudinal understanding of Welsh-qualified players and their development from initial identification through the pathway, professional rugby and senior international performance.
* Design and lead an integrated national player pipeline, connecting how Welsh rugby unearths, identifies, understands, tracks and accelerates the development of players from the pathway through to senior international rugby.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team, incorporating rugby AI, data/talent science and human factors expertise to create a more complete understanding of player performance, potential and development.
* Lead the talent contribution to What It Takes to Win and Welsh Rugby DNA, ensuring the characteristics and capabilities of the Future Welsh Player inform identification, development, selection/recruitment and succession planning.
* Work collaboratively across departments to create a genuinely trans-disciplinary view of the player by combining expert observation, coaching judgement, performance data, physical development, behavioural insight, maturation, opportunity and other relevant evidence.
* Develop a strategy and operational plan for a national and international talent intelligence and scouting network, connecting scouts, coaches, clubs and trusted talent contacts to systematically gather, challenge and share intelligence on current and emerging Welsh-qualified players.
* Establish and continually develop a world-leading scouting and Talent ID capability, creating consistent approaches to player observation, assessment, profiling and intelligence gathering, while ensuring the system actively searches for emerging talent, alternative perspectives and players who may otherwise remain unseen.
* Lead the development of modern player trajectory and potential modelling, using data science, longitudinal analysis and predictive techniques to understand development pathways, changing trajectories and probability of progression.
* Provide coaches and senior leaders with clear, decision-ready intelligence on player depth, future potential, development priorities, emerging opportunities and strategic risks across the national player population.
* Build a continuous learning system and agentic AI capability, automating key workflows while connecting evidence, decisions, interventions and outcomes to understand what genuinely predicts and accelerates future international performance and continually improves talent development.
* Maintain a future focus across talent science, AI and data, applying emerging approaches to accelerate the accuracy and depth of player insight and creates a sustainable competitive advantage for Welsh rugby
* Support WRU coach development activities through agreed workshops, mentoring and educational programmes.
* Act as an outstanding ambassador for Welsh Rugby, representing the organisation with integrity, collaboration and professionalism.
* Carry out duties in support of the WRU Strategic Mission, Purpose and Values.
**WRU Requirements**
The WRU require that individuals are proficient in IT skills, specifically Microsoft packages. Excellent written and verbal communications are essential, along with the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to communicate through the medium of Welsh and a Valid UK Driver's License is desirable. This role is subject to a basic/enhanced DBS check.

The WRU Group are committed to building diverse, high-performing and engaged teams across Welsh Rugby. We are ambitious about providing a people first culture where everyone can belong, be heard and respected. # Build Assurance Engineer
## Join Wessex Internet as a Build Assurance Engineer, auditing fibre builds, resolving defects and helping connect rural communities through quality work, career development and great benef...
We're looking for a **Build Assurance Engineer** to join our HSEQ team, supporting the quality assurance function across our full-fibre network builds.
Reporting to the Quality Manager, you'll play a key role in ensuring our builds meet the required quality, health and safety, and environmental standards. You'll work closely with our build teams to monitor compliance, carry out site audits, maintain accurate build data and manage defects through to final acceptance.
This is a hands-on role that combines field-based auditing with data analysis, system support and collaboration across our construction teams. You'll help identify issues early, drive improvements and ensure our network is built to the highest possible standard.
**What we offer our Build Assurance Engineers:**
* A starting salary of up to £38,500, dependent on experience.
* 25 days holiday + bank holidays, with the option to buy/sell up to 5 days.
* Private medical insurance, life assurance & income protection.
* Cycle to Work & Tech purchase schemes.
* Enhanced family leave policies.
* Staff broadband discount (75%).
* High street discounts on 100+ brands.
* Summer & Christmas team socials.
* Career development opportunities – Whether you want to lead a team or learn new skills, we’ll support your growth in our fast-moving business.
**What you'll be doing:**
* **Quality assurance and site audits:** Review build compliance data and carry out site audits to ensure work meets company standards, specifications and health, safety and environmental requirements.
* **Build data integrity:** Verify the accuracy and completeness of field data recorded within our GIS systems, ensuring reliable information throughout the build process.
* **Defect management:** Take ownership of the defect management process, tracking issues from identification through to resolution and final acceptance.
* **Compliance guidance:** Develop and distribute toolbox talks to help build teams understand and follow the required quality and compliance standards.
* **Project reporting:** Provide project managers with accurate information to support monitoring, reporting and escalation of quality and compliance issues.
* **Systems and team support:** Support build teams with system integration and compliance queries, working closely with the Senior Build Assurance Engineer to maintain an efficient build process.
**What we are looking for:**
* A demonstrable understanding of telecoms build standards, including civils, cabling, splicing and Physical Infrastructure Access (PIA) activities.
* An understanding of fibre deployment methodologies.
* Strong IT skills and the ability to learn and adapt to new systems.
* A methodical approach to work, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards.
* The ability to work collaboratively with field teams and project stakeholders to identify and resolve issues.
* Previous experience auditing FTTP builds and working in telecoms civils would be advantageous.
## Qualifications and tickets
The following qualifications or tickets would be advantageous:
* SA002
* SA001
* NRSWA Supervisor
* SSSTS
A **valid UK driving licence** is required for this role.
**Ready to make a difference?**
If you have the right experience, take pride in quality workmanship and want to play a key role in building a reliable full-fibre network for rural communities, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and help us connect the communities that need us most.

*“It's as if Time Out, Amex and Monzo had a baby”* - Will T, Yonder Member
We’re building the financial membership of the future. One that works for how you live now. Not how your parents banked in the ‘90s.
Yonder combines credit or debit in one membership, designed to be fair, flexible, and actually enjoyable to use. No confusing terms. No dusty points system. Just rewards that *actually* feel rewarding - from bao to beer to a boarding pass.

Over the last year we've added a debit card, a free membership tier, hundreds of new independent partners around the country, countless product improvements and our personal favourite, Yonder Hotels, a new way to use Yonder points on hotels around the world. We've maintained a 4.5 TrustPilot rating and our customers really love us (and we love them back... hi!).
Over the last few years, we’ve grown from just an idea to a beautiful, fully regulated financial product that our members absolutely love - especially the support we provide them. Experiences bring our product to life. Whether it's a city break, a ski trip, a sold-out gig or a West End opening night, our members trust us to curate Experiences that help them live financially rewarding lives.

You'll inherit an established book of partners, own the category plan and its revenue target, and lead new business across travel brands (OTAs, tour operators, hotel groups, airlines, holiday providers) and entertainment brands (ticketing platforms, promoters, venues, theatres and attractions).
You'll work closely with our SDR and Partner Success Manager, and you'll be accountable for the spend and revenue the category drives through our partner rewards network. * Structuring commercial deals that work for both sides, whether that's a commission-based travel partnership, an affiliate network deal, or an access deal in entertainment such as presales, hospitality packages and member-only allocations
* Developing a deep understanding of the problems travel and entertainment brands are trying to solve, and building new value props and commercial structures that drive incremental revenue
* Analysing campaign performance, optimising partner campaigns, and reporting on how the category is performing to the leadership team and the wider business

You've built pipeline from scratch, you know how to manage volume without losing quality, and you want a place where that drive is matched and rewarded.

# Head On - Senior Youth Participation Officer

YoungMinds and its coalition partners are delivering a Welcome Trust-funded program designed to support young people aged 18–25 to take part in a meaningful, skills-based journey into mental health advocacy and influencing. Part of the *Head On* campaign, the program responds to the urgent need to build stronger public and political pressure for improved mental health provision, by supporting young people most affected by current narratives to engage confidently with decision-makers and wider audiences. The program will bring young people together to co‐produce and shape a youth advocacy pathway, followed by a structured training offer and opportunities to apply their learning in practice. Participants will explore and use a range of public engagement approaches—including media, creative campaigning and direct engagement with MPs—to design and deliver advocacy activity at constituency and national level. Through a blend of co‐production sessions, training workshops and real-world activity, young people will develop the skills, confidence and connections needed to influence change. The Senior Youth Participation Officer will play a key role in coordinating delivery across all phases of the program, ensuring activity is well-organised, inclusive and rooted in strong youth participation practice. Acting as the primary point of contact for young people, you will support their engagement, wellbeing and experience, while ensuring their voices shape program development. Working closely with internal teams and partners, you will support the transition from co‐production into delivery and real-world advocacy, helping to create a safe, empowering environment and embedding anti‐oppressive approaches throughout.

# ZSL Seascape Programme – Project & Engagement Officer

## Purpose of the role
We are looking for a motivated Project & Engagement Officer to support the delivery of an exciting marine restoration project across North Wales. This is an opportunity for someone passionate about marine conservation, community engagement and partnership working to help shape the future of our coastal and marine environments.
Working closely with the Project Manager and the Engagement and Partnership Coordinator at Bangor University, you will build relationships with fishers, coastal communities and partner organisations, coordinate project activities and support the delivery of a Fisheries Advisory Group. You will play an important role in ensuring that local knowledge, experiences and perspectives help inform plans for marine habitat restoration across the Menai seascape.
You will also contribute to the development of a Five-Year Seascape Restoration Plan, helping to support nature recovery, sustainable fisheries and collaborative conservation across North Wales. Through this role, you will contribute to ZSL 200, supporting evidence-led conservation, strengthening partnerships and empowering coastal communities to play an active role in restoring and protecting marine ecosystems for the future.
This is an 18-month, fixed-term contract working 22.5 hours per week, with a pro-rata salary of £17,503.80 per annum.
**Key Responsibilities:**
* **Project Coordination & Delivery**: Coordinate project activities, monitor progress against key milestones and objectives, and maintain effective project management, reporting and governance systems to support successful delivery.
* **Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships:** Build strong relationships with fishers, seafood businesses, coastal communities and partner organisations, ensuring inclusive engagement and meaningful participation in marine restoration planning.
* **Fisheries Advisory Group Coordination:** Coordinate and support the Fisheries Advisory Group, ensuring fisheries knowledge, local expertise and stakeholder perspectives inform project development and decision-making.
* **Seascape Restoration Planning:** Support the development of the Five-Year Seascape Restoration Plan by gathering and integrating local knowledge, identifying opportunities for community involvement, and supporting long-term marine recovery and stewardship.
* **Communications, Reporting & Representation:** Represent the project at meetings, workshops and events, develop engaging project communications and reports, and contribute to monitoring and evaluation to demonstrate impact and inform future conservation work.
## About You
* Experience coordinating conservation, environmental or community engagement projects, ideally involving multiple partners, stakeholders or local communities.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage diverse groups, facilitate meetings and workshops, and support collaborative decision-making.
* Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines and deliver project activities effectively.
* An understanding of marine conservation, fisheries and coastal ecosystems in the UK, with a commitment to collaborative approaches to nature recovery.
* Excellent written and analytical skills, including the ability to prepare reports and presentations, analyse stakeholder feedback and communicate information to a range of audiences.
* A degree in marine biology, conservation, environmental science, social sciences or a related subject, or equivalent practical experience.
* A full UK driving licence, alongside a willingness to travel across North Wales and attend occasional evening or weekend events.
This role is subject to standard pre-employment checks, including confirmation of your right to work in the UK. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
ZSL recognises that conservation is one of the least diverse sectors, and we actively encourage applications from candidates who identify as part of underrepresented communities. We are committed to building a supportive and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and celebrate the value of having a team of employees with diverse skills, experiences, and heritage.

## Description
About Zyte
Zyte is a leader in web data extraction. Our full-stack Zyte API and world-class data services help thousands of companies, from individual developers to global enterprises, turn the web into reliable, structured data. We're a remote-first, globally distributed team that ships fast and lets results speak.
This is a transformative moment for web data, and AI is reshaping both sides of the market. The world needs web data more than ever: to train models, power agents and feed AI applications, so the audience for web data is exploding - creating new personas and new buying journeys almost overnight. At the same time AI is changing how that data is collected - from manual work by engineers to automation with AI.
Zyte is unique in solving both challenges of web data - the software needed for reliable access to websites and the AI and skills needed to turn web content into structured data. We have an important mission in the AI revolution.
The role
We're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to lead our self-serve acquisition and growth journeys across the channels used by personas hungry for web data. Our users are engineers, data teams and the builders of AI agents, and your job is to understand what they seek, what they try first and what convinces them to stay.
You'll lead conversion and growth across channels: our website, agents an the developer ecosystem. You'll be product owner for the website and application UI and will take a data driven approach to customer acquisition and growth, from traffic through trial, activation and subscription, right up to an account-managed relationship.
Our goal is to engage 500,000 developers next year who need web data and this role is central to converting them. In this role you'll shape the rhythm of funnels and experiments, ideating and iterating with a talented team on how we can improve experiences, find truths in data and build on the insight of customers to figure out the next growth step. You'll be fascinated by how engineers evaluate tools, how AI is changing the way they build and what it takes to earn their trust. You'll work to explode an audience in a market that is itself exploding, and to be able to point at the growth curve and say "I did that".
What you'll do
Manage the self-serve funnel end-to-end. Define, measure and improve every stage: signup, trial, activation, conversion to paid and expansion.
Be product owner for the website and product UI. Set the roadmap and priorities for our web presence and platform UX, working directly with the development lead, engineers and designers to ship improvements that capture demand and drive funnel activity.
Optimise the funnel as a conversion mechanism - design and run experiments, work closely with our design and product marketing teams on formats, copy and narratives for conversion.
Optimise PLG journeys that start in the developer ecosystem. Optimise the buying journeys that begin in open source and in the emerging ecosystems of agents, turning developer adoption and ecosystem presence into activation and growth. This means deeply understanding developer workflows: docs, SDKs, code examples and the first ten minutes of hands-on experience.
Build intelligent customer data and nurture growth. Build customer data based on usage and firmographics, and use this to nurture customers for growth with tailored onboarding, relevant content and (with our RevOps function) identify when our sales professionals should reach out and make contact. .
Run a rigorous experimentation practice. Develop hypotheses, ship A/B tests and funnel experiments, and report results honestly, doubling down on what works and killing what doesn't.
